clean_body: Women and girls are worth fighting for. | | | | | | | | Welcome to Keeping Up with Kathryn Harvey. A weekly digest covering South Carolina politics and opportunities for engagement and action in the Upstate. | Women and girls are worth fighting for. | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | I’ve spent my career standing up for women and girls. Not because it was easy— but because it was necessary.When I first stepped into this work, I didn’t know just how much it would shape me. How much it would challenge me. How much it would matter.Years ago, I had the extraordinary privilege of working on through Sesame Workshop —the global nonprofit behind Sesame Street. There, I poured my energy into supporting initiatives that gave young girls a voice—not just to sing or smile, but to be strong, to be curious, to lead, to dream big. Because I believed then—and still do—that when girls see themselves reflected, they start to believe in their power.Now I’m back in my home town of Spartanburg, South Carolina—a place I love deeply. But let’s be honest: there’s work to do here. There are things happening in this state that deeply affect women—our choices, our bodies, our futures.And while I may not be working for women and girls around the globe anymore, I’m still fighting here at home with amazing organizations like the . Because there is still so much worth fighting for.This Women’s History Month, I’m reminded of the women who came before us—who marched, who taught, who healed, who built, who sacrificed. And I’m reminded that history isn’t just something we read about. It’s something we create—every single day.So, if you’re wondering whether your voice matters, whether your advocacy is too small, whether your presence can make a difference—let me tell you: it does.And we need you to stay in this fight. | | Speaking of supporting women... | | | | | | | | | | | | Emerge SC Happy Hour March 12 at 5:30pm, Greenville Learn about Tina Belge’s campaign for City Council and meet the new Executive Director of Emerge SC, Allison Terracio. Hear about her plan to elect more Democratic women in SC. Both Allison and Tina love to talk affordable housing, so you're in for a treat! | | | | | | | | | | | | Celebrate our Sister Senators March 20 at 5:30pm in Charleston Join us for a sneak peek of the upcoming Sister Senators Documentary & a moderated conversation by Grace Cowan. If you are interested in a contribution, please reach out to sistersenatorsfilm@gmail.com. | | | | | | | | | | | | | | So you want to run for office? Because of their bravery and dedication neither bill is currently scheduled for another hearing. This is a huge victory, but we need to continue to write letters and make calls. Your voices have already made a difference, and we must keep the momentum going. Thank you to the ACLU and WREN for leading the charge. Hear . Hear | | | | | | | | | | | The South Carolina House has kicked off Budget Week, when lawmakers come together to amend, debate, and vote on the state budget bill. This process shapes the funding for vital programs and services that impact families across our state. Hi Peter,

As you’ve likely noticed, there’s something changing in American culture...

From 1987 until 2012, there was such an insignificant shift in the idea that “women should return to their traditional role in society” that the Pew Research Center removed the question from their survey altogether.

However, according to the Views of the Electorate Research Survey, the percentage of **Republican men who think women should return to their traditional gender roles has increased from 28% in May 2022 to 48% in November 2024.**
---
[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/103705393/532989980/1701071684?refcode=EM_F_250312stat_N_GM_90DO_8_G_B_Logo&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNy8xLzg4NDk1IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjliYTU1N2ZjLTQxZmYtZWYxMS05MGNkLTAwMjI0ODJhOWZiNyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=75Rx_zzZ7pmQO9jGxJpecbrig_Xzw_OUPjdcN8KheZA=)
---
Similar patterns are also evident around views of traditional masculinity. Three-fourths of Republicans (men and women) believe that changes in “what it means to be a man” have been bad for society. Meanwhile, as of 2024, 79% and 67% of Republican men and women, respectively, believe that our “society as a whole has become too soft and feminine.”

[**At Her Bold Move, we believe just the opposite. Having more women in our government would improve society – and, as studies have shown, even bring us closer to world peace. We refuse to go back to a time when women didn’t have autonomy in decisions about their own lives. Help support women running for office this year by chipping in $20.25 or more today. →**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/103705394/532989981/1701071684?refcode=EM_F_250312stat_N_GM_90DO_8_G_B_L1&amount=20.25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNy8xLzg4NDk1IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjliYTU1N2ZjLTQxZmYtZWYxMS05MGNkLTAwMjI0ODJhOWZiNyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=75Rx_zzZ7pmQO9jGxJpecbrig_Xzw_OUPjdcN8KheZA=)

We want to make one thing clear: women should have the freedom to pursue absolutely any lifestyle __they choose.__ But when society – or our government – impose limited lifestyle options on American women, that’s when we have cause for concern.

**Many of our mothers and grandmothers remember a time when women couldn't even open their own credit cards or apply for high-paying jobs. None of the rights women have today were handed to us by the men in power. Women fought TIRELESSLY for them. They committed to never giving up and won SO MANY critical battles.**

That’s why we need women in the rooms where decisions about our lives, our health, and our bodies are being made. We wouldn’t need to fight these battles if more of the people making laws were women. We need more women in government – we need more women lawmakers.

[**At Her Bold Move, we’re making that happen. But we need your help, Peter. Join us in our efforts to defend that hard-fought progress on behalf of our mothers, our grandmothers, our daughters, and our friends by ensuring women are always in the rooms where decisions are being made. New York Republican Rep. Nicole Malliotakis **[defended President Trump's tariff maneuver on CNN,](https://substack.com/redirect/c7208639-7de9-4fc6-946e-cd276475c862?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** arguing that Trump is addressing economic concerns by bringing substantial investment into the American economy and aiming to eliminate fentanyl deaths resulting from an unsecure border.
[Watch Video](https://substack.com/redirect/c7208639-7de9-4fc6-946e-cd276475c862?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
[](https://substack.com/redirect/c7208639-7de9-4fc6-946e-cd276475c862?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
"Donald Trump was asked over the weekend about a possible recession happening this year,.. is that a risk you think is worth it?" the CNN reporter asked the congresswoman.
Malliotakis said the **[Biden administration is to blame for the much of the economic conditions](https://substack.com/redirect/c7208639-7de9-4fc6-946e-cd276475c862?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** that would lead to a recession. "You can't disregard the damage that the Biden administration did to our economy with their regulations, with their inflationary spending!"
"You gotta remember, President Trump has already brought in **[$2 trillion in private investment,](https://substack.com/redirect/63705619-f930-44c1-b22b-1f4462a03ba4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** " Malliotakis explained. "He's only been in office for a month, every other week we're hearing about a new company who is repariating, manufacturing or expanding operations here in the United States!"
The CNN host pushed back, citing Target and Best Buy who said prices are going up in direct relation to Trump's tariffs.
Malliotakis argued back that Biden kept and increased tariffs on China as well, claiming CNN is just looking to blame President Trump. She continued to say that Trump's tariffs are worth the risk in the markets because **[they address more important issues like fentanyl coming over an unsecure border](https://substack.com/redirect/c7208639-7de9-4fc6-946e-cd276475c862?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** that our neighbors haven't cooperated with us in fixing.
"Our young people, who are being poisoned by fentanyl, we need them to be productive and contribute to our economy!" she said. "Not stoned and perhaps killed because of fentynal coming over our border!"

# _**Resurfaced**_**: Tom Homan DESTROYS censured Al Green in front of the entire country**
Trump Border Czar and former I.C.E. Director Tom Homan erupted at far-left Democrat Al Green during an intense hearing on immigration and family separation policy.
[Watch Video](https://substack.com/redirect/2d06f8b0-846e-467a-8f56-d30895456800?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
[](https://substack.com/redirect/2d06f8b0-846e-467a-8f56-d30895456800?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
"I'm not sure what you mean by zero tolerance," Green told Homan. "Are you saying no one ever coming to the United States? Is that your zero tolerance police?"
"No..." Homan corrected the congressman. "You're referring to family separation, which has happened under numerous presidents, not just this president."
"Whenever someone gets arrested for a crime they get booked into a jail, their child can't go with them. Just like if I got arrested tonight my child couldn't go with me!"
Green pushed back, saying that the illegal immigrants in question committed "no crimes."
Homan was forced to state the obvious yet again, **["If you enter the United States illegally, it's a crime..."](https://substack.com/redirect/2d06f8b0-846e-467a-8f56-d30895456800?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** The former I.C.E. Director explained that he believes that the issue of family separations would be made much better if congress closed the immigration loop holes he had previously requested.
"We're asking congress, look, we already proved this worked under the Obama administration! How come we're not doing it now?!" Homan asked. "I think congress needs to close this loophole,... This isn't just about securing our border, it's about saving lives! If we close these loopholes, we're going to save women from being sexually assaulted, we're going to save children from dying!"
Watch the powerful moment here:
[Watch Video](https://substack.com/redirect/2d06f8b0-846e-467a-8f56-d30895456800?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Rep. Al Green was censured for disrupting President Trump's speech to congress last week, standing up and shouting at the PResident while waiving his cane, then refusing to leave on request.
Speaker of the House Mike Johnson was forced to kick the disruptive democrat out of the chambers, escorted by the Sergeant at Arms.
"Mr. Green take your seat sir!" Johnson scolded, before ordering Green's removal.

Hello -

As you may have heard by now, I just announced my candidacy for Governor. The first 48 hours were a whirlwind. We held four launch events across Ohio, my wife introduced me, and our two young boys took the opportunity to run around ripping off their suit jackets.

_**If I 'm being honest - I'm having the time of my life!**_
---

---
My campaign is drawing thousands of supporters in every corner of Ohio AND across the country who want a SLEDGEHAMMER taken to the system that prioritizes victimhood over merit, virtue signaling over morality, and illegal immigrants over American citizens.

**[That's what this movement is all about.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2ztflv2ff9is731b44hdjmg2lnjh4rrir0m9lhuu0_rp22sh2s8i6eob4ctie1o71c1h2bs "That’s what this movement is all about.")**

But that requires seismic changes to the status quo - as I'm sure you can imagine my candidacy is ruffling a LOT of feathers in certain circles...

**MINUTES after launching my campaign, special interests, deep state operatives, and establishment power brokers moved to snuff out this campaign for good. **
| - The media ambushed me with fake news hit pieces
---
- They published letters attacking my character
- Special interest bosses lied about my bold agenda
- My Liberal opponent fired off a swarm of fundraising emails
- Even some "Republicans" took to disgraceful personal attacks

This is par for the course when you challenge a corrupt system. They come for you because they know it's the only way the gravy train keeps rolling.

_Our President knows this all too well. _

And just like we're seeing with him, the powers-at-be are coming for me fast and hard. That's why I'm coming to you now with a humble ask.

**I 'm hoping you'll help fuel this campaign across the finish line. [Every donation - especially in these early days - allows us to spread our message far and wide and keep this campaign afloat.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z27d6jsmci2ql22tm5gr4502du08506gfnoe9re0_rp22sh2s8i6eob4ctie1o71c1h2bs "Every donation – especially in these early days – allows us to spread our message far and wide and keep this campaign afloat.") **

The amount is far less important than the number of folks who step up. So, with all that in mind, can I ask you for a donation to help fund a WINNING campaign?

| | [**CONTRIBUTE $4 HERE**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zp6go61vs5ijt963f7vma5u9io9ll5reuchael90_rp22sh2s8i6eob4ctie1o71c1h2bs)

---
| | [**CONTRIBUTE ANY AMOUNT**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zsplf2lk9anqtfhn5munt81jqivhoue6p3bo8bk0_rp22sh2s8i6eob4ctie1o71c1h2bs)

Whether it's a few bucks or a few hundred bucks, your support makes a big difference in this campaign. **Without it, I don 't like our chances. **

Regardless, thanks for everything you've done to help elect President Trump and Republicans in Congress.

Together, we'll make history!

Vivek Ramaswamy

body:
The media ambushed me with fake news hit pieces, they published letters attacking

| |

---
Hello -

As you may have heard by now, I just announced my candidacy for Governor. The first 48 hours were a whirlwind. We held four launch events across Ohio, my wife introduced me, and our two young boys took the opportunity to run around ripping off their suit jackets.

_**If I 'm being honest - I'm having the time of my life!**_
---
| [](https://e.firstlook.news/rd/9z2zc0k7bhdimod0obj4if62muatcqpi6gi4827ru7o_rp22sh2s8i6eob4c3g60or2cth2bs)

---
- They published letters attacking my character
- Special interest bosses lied about my bold agenda

_Our President knows this all too well. _

And just like we're seeing with him, the powers-at-be are coming for me fast and hard. That's why I'm coming to you now with a humble ask.

name: Malcolm Kenyatta (via Democrats.org)
subject: An update for Derek:
body:
---
Derek, I know the day-to-day chaos we’re all experiencing under a second Trump administration is frustrating and exhausting. I know it might be tempting to tune out completely, but I’m personally asking you to stay in this fight. Here’s why: What we’re seeing in this administration is the worst reverse Robin Hood that we could have imagined, where we have the wealthiest people in the world doing everything they can every single day to rip away hard-fought protections that Democrats achieved in the first place. So we have to continue to tell the truth, and we have to be aggressive about communicating to the American people what we have done and what we stand for. And most of all we need to elect Democrats at the local level right now that can act as a check against Trump and Republicans’ disastrous policies. What happens in each of our communities has a huge impact. To win again nationally, Democrats must win down the ballot, too. And that’s where I’m asking for your help. We’ve got important special elections coming up in states like Pennsylvania, Wisconsin, and Florida. You can get involved from anywhere by [clicking this link](https://ak.democrats.org/go/14282?refcode=em_20250312_2942_fr&t=2&akid=2942%2E22930333%2EWwGwLW), or you can [pitch in a few dollars to support the DNC’s work to win elections all over the country, at all levels of government.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-march-2025/?refcode=em_20250312_2942_fr&amount=3&refcode2=2942_22930333_WwGwLW&akid=2942%2E22930333%2EWwGwLW) Getting engaged _now_ is the only way we’re going to be able to fight back when Republicans treat working people like garbage. And it’s the only way we’re going to elect Democrats this year, next year, and beyond who will check Trump and his allies’ power in their own communities. Thank you in advance for stepping up today, Malcolm Malcolm Kenyatta
Vice Chair
Democratic National Committee | [](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-march-2025/?amount=3&refcode=em_20250312_2942_fr&refcode2=2942_22930333_WwGwLW&akid=2942%2E22930333%2EWwGwLW)

name: Barack Obama
subject: Hope
body:
The best way to not feel hopeless is to get up and do something.

Living in a democracy is about recognizing that our point of view won't always win out, but continuing to fight for the change we believe in.
Since the last election, the foundational principles of our democracy have been challenged, and it would be easy to give in to fear and despair.
But the change we seek -- the change we need -- will not come if we wait for some other person or some other time.
The best way to make a difference is to get up and do something. Don't wait for the next election. Go out and make a difference right now.
Because through your action, you will fill others with hope. And you might just fill yourself with hope.
Today, I am asking you to do something that will give Democrats across the country hope that the next election will be different.
[**I am asking you to contribute $5, $50 or whatever you can afford to the Democratic National Committee today. body:
Remember – if we lose the Florida Special Election, the Democrats could dismantle our entire Majority AND Trump’s legislative agenda.

| |
---
| | | This is Steve Scalise -

I'm respectfully asking you to pay attention right now.

The Florida Special Elections are LESS THAN THREE WEEKS AWAY and our House Majority hangs in the balance. I have an urgent message from our FL-01 candidate, Jimmy Patronis, and he is relying on me to make sure every single MAGA supporter sees it.

**He 's our candidate to backfill for Matt Gaetz and he's the right man for the job. **

Remember - if we lose the Florida Special Election, the Democrats could dismantle our entire Majority AND Trump's legislative agenda.

_**[So please, will you take a minute to review Jimmy's message and respond with the urgent support he needs?](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zevt8l1q56t7ienf97qrovn2220dv1jbl1do20no_rp22sh2s8i6eob4c3g6cpj4chh2bs "So please, will you take a minute to review Jimmy's message and respond with the urgent support he needs?")**_

Every second counts.

- Majority Leader Scalise

** ORIGINAL MESSAGE FROM JIMMY PATRONIS -> **

---
Hi - my name is Jimmy Patronis.

**As of 8:07 PM Tuesday, January 28th, I 'm officially the GOP nominee for the FL-01 Special Election to replace Matt Gaetz in Congress.** I'm honored to have the trust of voters AND of President Trump whose endorsement helped put me over the top.

While I'm over the moon to be here today, I'm also reminded of the stakes of this Special Election...

House Republicans are BARELY clinging to their Majority and control of the House. I'll say this in a different way: If Democrats manage to win this Special Election and the two others for Mike Waltz and Elise Stefanik, they'll sweep back into power THIS YEAR.

That's why I'm working with Majority Leader Steve Scalise to sweep all three Special Elections - and save our Majority - so we can deliver on President Trump's agenda.

**_[If you want to support these critical efforts, I humbly ask every Conservative in America to kick in a few bucks before my Special Election.](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z1n2rkletbb1bgksstdla21m1isdk7f88n0k0ub8_rp22sh2s8i6eob4c3g6cpj4chh2bs "If you want to support these critical efforts, I humbly ask every Conservative in America to kick in a few bucks before my Special Election. ")_**

_Would you be willing to step up when we need you most? _
---
**[](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2znsgobcl057t3kjt047qpv5r0l7u1v383p2ckaq8_rp22sh2s8i6eob4c3g6cpj4chh2bs)[**YES >>**](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z4ig2h8f7446h6os1tlq5aaiggln64u28r39o2u8_rp22sh2s8i6eob4c3g6cpj4chh2bs)_[**NO >>**](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zhfgndse7enobelrhqa39chvmp0gdpr21a2vgvjg_rp22sh2s8i6eob4c3g6cpj4chh2bs)**
---
| [](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2znol3ld2fujl8v90mmks1aselhi2hdvb5ngkohq0_rp22sh2s8i6eob4c3g6cpj4chh2bs "Jimmy Patronis and Donald Trump")
---
Serving the State of Florida has been an honor of a lifetime. I went from refilling ketchup bottles at my family's seafood restaurant to being the CFO and Fire Marshal for the Sunshine State, and now being the Trump-endorsed GOP nominee to replace MAGA Warrior Matt Gaetz.

But I can only take this experience to Congress if I defeat the Democrats in this race.

Special Elections are notoriously expensive and Democrats are desperate to win back the House. **_[That's why I'm teaming up with Leader Scalise to help raise $50,000 from this email alone in the next 24 hours.](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zmafnttatjckq1brl3gnaen05scjptspuil6llko_rp22sh2s8i6eob4c3g6cpj4chh2bs "That’s why I’m teaming up with Leader Scalise to help raise $50,000 from this email alone in the next 24 hours.")_**

I JUST won my primary so hitting this goal so quickly would be a major show of force in this race.

**I know we can get there as long as everyone reading this agrees to send in just ten or twenty bucks. Can you do that for me?** **[**YES >>**](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zl684amcg1vr5kb17odmc7savse0a5jj8dhbh12g_rp22sh2s8i6eob4c3g6cpj4chh2bs)_[**NO >>**](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z3shu1p8l25vmjbep8ghbujj04vmeg1m7fujb2c8_rp22sh2s8i6eob4c3g6cpj4chh2bs)**Thank you for hearing me out.

I look forward to fighting for the America First values that you, me, President Trump, Leader Scalise, and Matt Gaetz believe in.

God bless you,
_- Jimmy_

**JIMMY PATRONIS**
GOP Nominee for the FL-01 Special Election

_A personal note from Majority Leader Steve Scalise:_

I'm humbled to announce that I am your new House Majority Leader. My first order of business is checking in with our best supporters, so I just launched my new** MAJORITY LEADER SURVEY** for that specific reason.

_**[I'd be honored to get your unfiltered thoughts, feedback, and opinions using this secure link.](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zklv5d8q34ir2r9i16m9pr9hm5uf1nf5bbh2gjs0_rp22sh2s8i6eob4c3g6cpj4chh2bs "I’d be honored to get your unfiltered thoughts, feedback, and opinions using this secure link.")**_

---
Thank you,

Steve Scalise
_House Majority Leader_

body:
Remember – if we lose the Florida Special Election, the Democrats could dismantle our entire Majority AND Trump’s legislative agenda.

| |
---
| | | This is Steve Scalise -

I'm respectfully asking you to pay attention right now.

The Florida Special Elections are LESS THAN THREE WEEKS AWAY and our House Majority hangs in the balance. I have an urgent message from our FL-01 candidate, Jimmy Patronis, and he is relying on me to make sure every single MAGA supporter sees it.

**He 's our candidate to backfill for Matt Gaetz and he's the right man for the job. **

Remember - if we lose the Florida Special Election, the Democrats could dismantle our entire Majority AND Trump's legislative agenda.

_**[So please, will you take a minute to review Jimmy's message and respond with the urgent support he needs?](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z0c3uoip4m05vi8horckfdpueg50jgoa98r9mqoo_rp22sh2s8i6eob4c3g6ap31c9h2bs "So please, will you take a minute to review Jimmy's message and respond with the urgent support he needs?")**_

Every second counts.

- Majority Leader Scalise

** ORIGINAL MESSAGE FROM JIMMY PATRONIS -> **

---
Hi - my name is Jimmy Patronis.

**As of 8:07 PM Tuesday, January 28th, I 'm officially the GOP nominee for the FL-01 Special Election to replace Matt Gaetz in Congress.** I'm honored to have the trust of voters AND of President Trump whose endorsement helped put me over the top.

While I'm over the moon to be here today, I'm also reminded of the stakes of this Special Election...

House Republicans are BARELY clinging to their Majority and control of the House. I'll say this in a different way: If Democrats manage to win this Special Election and the two others for Mike Waltz and Elise Stefanik, they'll sweep back into power THIS YEAR.

That's why I'm working with Majority Leader Steve Scalise to sweep all three Special Elections - and save our Majority - so we can deliver on President Trump's agenda.

**_[If you want to support these critical efforts, I humbly ask every Conservative in America to kick in a few bucks before my Special Election.](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z7ndflom9h851mi9ml1c5gmnfvf5pcggmnej2mho_rp22sh2s8i6eob4c3g6ap31c9h2bs "If you want to support these critical efforts, I humbly ask every Conservative in America to kick in a few bucks before my Special Election. ")_**

_Would you be willing to step up when we need you most? _
---
**[](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zbb99h4r66eg5blv48aprbv89trca3f0h0jkhu2o_rp22sh2s8i6eob4c3g6ap31c9h2bs)[**YES >>**](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z6949qf03bqa3q78jodqeobb49fr6jn2vscmmhpg_rp22sh2s8i6eob4c3g6ap31c9h2bs)_[**NO >>**](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zpa99o6s3jgl3d3jeqg5kvlvn8s5bkippmq28gp8_rp22sh2s8i6eob4c3g6ap31c9h2bs)**
---
| [](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z4ptrvhcp73oin13pbgmnfcn2qe5t2730m7drqe0_rp22sh2s8i6eob4c3g6ap31c9h2bs "Jimmy Patronis and Donald Trump")
---
Serving the State of Florida has been an honor of a lifetime. I went from refilling ketchup bottles at my family's seafood restaurant to being the CFO and Fire Marshal for the Sunshine State, and now being the Trump-endorsed GOP nominee to replace MAGA Warrior Matt Gaetz.

But I can only take this experience to Congress if I defeat the Democrats in this race.

Special Elections are notoriously expensive and Democrats are desperate to win back the House. **_[That's why I'm teaming up with Leader Scalise to help raise $50,000 from this email alone in the next 24 hours.](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zk2aoug3ifpcdpmordunsbrbusjog7v4imoe8gto_rp22sh2s8i6eob4c3g6ap31c9h2bs "That’s why I’m teaming up with Leader Scalise to help raise $50,000 from this email alone in the next 24 hours.")_**

I JUST won my primary so hitting this goal so quickly would be a major show of force in this race.

**I know we can get there as long as everyone reading this agrees to send in just ten or twenty bucks. Can you do that for me?** **[**YES >>**](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zd9jra6br3eeltuc0lo0ilnjdadugqno5mpumlm0_rp22sh2s8i6eob4c3g6ap31c9h2bs)_[**NO >>**](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zni7mc1n52a9fr0tdhcjl795ad61b28ktfbkft30_rp22sh2s8i6eob4c3g6ap31c9h2bs)**Thank you for hearing me out.

I look forward to fighting for the America First values that you, me, President Trump, Leader Scalise, and Matt Gaetz believe in.

God bless you,
_- Jimmy_

**JIMMY PATRONIS**
GOP Nominee for the FL-01 Special Election

Americans are pissed.
Over the last few weeks, we have received an outpouring of messages from people across the political spectrum--Democrats, independents, and even former Republicans--all asking the same question: _Do we need a new movement, a third party, or both?_ This isn't just a progressive concern. It's coming from moderates, centrists, and independents who are watching in frustration as the Democratic Party flounders. The corporate takeover of our government is undeniable, and the response from Democratic leadership is weak at best. People are realizing that politicians won't save us--_we_ will.
The question is, how?
This isn't the first time Americans have had to fight for real change. The people have always led movements, and politicians have only followed when forced. Throughout history, grassroots activism has been the catalyst for major political shifts. We are now living through another such moment in history where it is time to decide: do we build a movement to take back the Democratic Party, or do we create a new political force entirely? **Let 's Address This**
**More than 123,000 activists have subscribed to** _**Let 's Address This.** _**We are doing everything in our power to stave off fascism in the United States. Subscribe and join us.**

## Where We Are: A Failing Strategy
Democrats are losing ground. A [Quinnipiac University poll](https://substack.com/redirect/be175092-67d0-42e0-bbe2-d570a2c6d180?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) puts their approval rating at a historic low of just 21%, while Republicans are at a record-high 40%, and Trump himself has hit 45%--a number once thought impossible. The Democratic strategy isn't just failing; it's actively alienating voters.
For example, despite knowing for at least two years in advance that the right would enact the draconian Project 2025, Democratic leadership appears flat footed and blindsided, as if the 900 page manifesto was some closely held secret and not blasted across every corner of the Internet. Rather than present a coordinated, bold vision for the future, Democratic leadership seems paralyzed--afraid to act for fear of offending corporate donors, major PACs, or the mythical "middle" that no longer exists. This go-along-to-get-along mentality is making it impossible to counter the rising tide of right-wing extremism, which is now [disappearing legal residents](https://substack.com/redirect/ee7a8797-b241-4522-9ad9-2187fe3be88c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) for the 'crime' of exercising their Constitutionally protected free speech.
## Why Congress is Weak and Ineffective
Many members of Congress are terrified to take risks. Even as the opposition party, too many Democrats rely on corporate donors and PACs like AIPAC, who dictate their positions. Instead of fighting for bold solutions, they play it safe and prioritize their careers over the urgent needs of the people.
The result?
A party too scared to lead, too compromised to be effective, and too weak to counteract fascism. If we're serious about saving our democracy, we need to take the power out of the hands of corporate interests and put it back where it belongs--with the people.
## How Change Happens: Lessons from History
Throughout history, political transformation has come from outside the establishment:
✅ The Republican Party itself was born from a collapsing Whig Party in the 1850s.
✅ The Progressive movement forced major reforms in the early 1900s, including women's suffrage and labor rights.
✅ Globally, movements like France's En Marche and Germany's Green Party have disrupted traditional politics.
Meanwhile, major social movements--including civil rights, labor rights, and LGBTQ+ rights--didn't start with electoral power, but with relentless grassroots activism.
Both of us have directly challenged these entrenched systems. Marie fought against corporate influence in Congress, only to be targeted by establishment forces. As a human rights lawyer, I've worked to expose injustice, often facing overwhelming opposition. We see the need for reform as a minimum, and possibly much more.

[ Upgrade to paid](https://substack..9psesPoCREBRK43kxK49B46F19KC3aNPjV0Vs6lxfv0?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget-preamble&utm_content=158893518)
## What Would a New Movement or Party Look Like?
Any effort to reclaim democracy must be structured, strategic, and built for the long haul. This could include a rebranded, powerful caucus within the Democratic Party--one that enforces accountability and actually delivers for the people. Another oft mentioned path is a whole new third-party coalition that starts local, wins elections, and builds national credibility on the tenants of economic, social, and climate justice. Or finally, a hybrid approach--running candidates both within and outside the Democratic Party to challenge corporate influence from all angles. Regardless of the approach, the movement must accomplish three indisputable things. It must:
* Solve real problems, not play political games or engage in culture wars.
* Include everyone--never throwing any group under the bus.
* Build and sustain without the influence of dark PAC or corporate money.

## The Biggest Obstacle: Money
According to End Citizens United, [more than 90% of Americans](https://substack.com/redirect/fb0f01cb-a539-4763-a6ce-d975935eb810?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) across the political landscape want corporate money out of politics. How depressing then, that despite this overwhelming unity in the American people, corporate money dominates both major parties with no hint of slowing down? Any new movement will require millions of dollars to run a viable operation, pay staff, secure ballot access, and reach voters, and do so without corporate support.
Without a strong financial strategy, even the best-organized movement will struggle. But we cannot and should not create a movement or a third party on the same corporate funded pillars of the two current parties. Therefore, we need mass movement of people, small dollar contributions, and a categorical rejection of all dark pac and corporate money. The truth is, this is extremely difficult, but it is also worthwhile.
Other Challenges: Egos, Intimidation, and Establishment Resistance
The political world is full of gatekeepers, careerists, and bullies who maintain control through intimidation. Any movement--whether within the Democratic Party or outside of it--will face resistance from all sides.
Centrist politicians who stand for nothing will fear-monger about "splitting the vote," while corporate media will dismiss such a movement as unrealistic. But history shows that bold, people-driven movements succeeded when they ran on principles and justice, and refused to back down to intimidation and threats.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..9psesPoCREBRK43kxK49B46F19KC3aNPjV0Vs6lxfv0?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=158893518)
## Signs of Hope: The People Are Already Leading
Despite the failures of some elected Democrats, grassroots activism is making a real impact:
✅ Unionization efforts are at an all-time high, securing better wages and conditions
✅ Boycotts are working, forcing corporations to cut ties with extremists.
✅ State Attorneys General are successfully suing corrupt politicians and reversing cruel policies.
✅ Local organizers are flipping school boards and city councils.
These wins prove that direct action, economic leverage, and legal strategies are working--even when Congress refuses to act. Change won't happen overnight. Whether we build a movement within the Democratic Party or create a new political force, we need a plan. The best approach is to start small, win, and then scale up.
* Pilot programs: Identify winnable races and back bold candidates.
* Local wins: Focus on city councils, state legislatures, and ballot initiatives.
* Expand nationally: Build credibility, public trust, and public financial support over time.

This process could take years--maybe a decade. Unfortunately, there's no quick flip of a switch to stop the increasing right wing authoritarianism harming working people every single day. But without a long-term strategy, we are doomed to repeat the same mistakes. And while it will take time to build a justice based movement, the good news is that all the pieces are here and with us now. We have the ideas, the vision, and the people fed up with the status quo. Sadly, the Democratic Party's approval is in free fall, and Trumpism is gaining strength. We need to lead with vigor and consistency now, if we hope to uphold justice tomorrow and for the next generation.
We wrote this because we hear you when you tell us you are pissed. Let's channel that anger into a thoughtful path forward, and form that promised more perfect Union, together.

The people will lead--politicians will follow.
Let's get to work and build this movement together.

Exploring a sensitive question that too many seem too afraid to ask | | and | Mar 12 | | | ---|---|--- | | | | | | | | | | | Americans are pissed. Over the last few weeks, we have received an outpouring of messages from people across the political spectrum--Democrats, independents, and even former Republicans--all asking the same question: Do we need a new movement, a third party, or both? This isn't just a progressive concern. It's coming from moderates, centrists, and independents who are watching in frustration as the Democratic Party flounders. The corporate takeover of our government is undeniable, and the response from Democratic leadership is weak at best. People are realizing that politicians won't save us--we will. The question is, how? This isn't the first time Americans have had to fight for real change. The people have always led movements, and politicians have only followed when forced. Throughout history, grassroots activism has been the catalyst for major political shifts. We are now living through another such moment in history where it is time to decide: do we build a movement to take back the Democratic Party, or do we create a new political force entirely? Let 's Address This More than 123,000 activists have subscribed to Let 's Address This. We are doing everything in our power to stave off fascism in the United States. Subscribe and join us. | | ---|---|--- Where We Are: A Failing Strategy Democrats are losing ground. A puts their approval rating at a historic low of just 21%, while Republicans are at a record-high 40%, and Trump himself has hit 45%--a number once thought impossible. The Democratic strategy isn't just failing; it's actively alienating voters. For example, despite knowing for at least two years in advance that the right would enact the draconian Project 2025, Democratic leadership appears flat footed and blindsided, as if the 900 page manifesto was some closely held secret and not blasted across every corner of the Internet. Rather than present a coordinated, bold vision for the future, Democratic leadership seems paralyzed--afraid to act for fear of offending corporate donors, major PACs, or the mythical "middle" that no longer exists. This go-along-to-get-along mentality is making it impossible to counter the rising tide of right-wing extremism, which is now for the 'crime' of exercising their Constitutionally protected free speech. Why Congress is Weak and Ineffective Many members of Congress are terrified to take risks. Even as the opposition party, too many Democrats rely on corporate donors and PACs like AIPAC, who dictate their positions. Instead of fighting for bold solutions, they play it safe and prioritize their careers over the urgent needs of the people. The result? A party too scared to lead, too compromised to be effective, and too weak to counteract fascism. If we're serious about saving our democracy, we need to take the power out of the hands of corporate interests and put it back where it belongs--with the people. How Change Happens: Lessons from History Throughout history, political transformation has come from outside the establishment: ✅ The Republican Party itself was born from a collapsing Whig Party in the 1850s. ✅ The Progressive movement forced major reforms in the early 1900s, including women's suffrage and labor rights. ✅ Globally, movements like France's En Marche and Germany's Green Party have disrupted traditional politics. Meanwhile, major social movements--including civil rights, labor rights, and LGBTQ+ rights--didn't start with electoral power, but with relentless grassroots activism. Both of us have directly challenged these entrenched systems. Marie fought against corporate influence in Congress, only to be targeted by establishment forces. As a human rights lawyer, I've worked to expose injustice, often facing overwhelming opposition. We see the need for reform as a minimum, and possibly much more. Finding value in this article? Join the movement as a paid subscriber! What Would a New Movement or Party Look Like? Any effort to reclaim democracy must be structured, strategic, and built for the long haul. This could include a rebranded, powerful caucus within the Democratic Party--one that enforces accountability and actually delivers for the people. Another oft mentioned path is a whole new third-party coalition that starts local, wins elections, and builds national credibility on the tenants of economic, social, and climate justice. Or finally, a hybrid approach--running candidates both within and outside the Democratic Party to challenge corporate influence from all angles. Regardless of the approach, the movement must accomplish three indisputable things. It must: Solve real problems, not play political games or engage in culture wars. Include everyone--never throwing any group under the bus. Build and sustain without the influence of dark PAC or corporate money. The Biggest Obstacle: Money According to End Citizens United, across the political landscape want corporate money out of politics. How depressing then, that despite this overwhelming unity in the American people, corporate money dominates both major parties with no hint of slowing down? Any new movement will require millions of dollars to run a viable operation, pay staff, secure ballot access, and reach voters, and do so without corporate support. Without a strong financial strategy, even the best-organized movement will struggle. But we cannot and should not create a movement or a third party on the same corporate funded pillars of the two current parties. Therefore, we need mass movement of people, small dollar contributions, and a categorical rejection of all dark pac and corporate money. The truth is, this is extremely difficult, but it is also worthwhile. Other Challenges: Egos, Intimidation, and Establishment Resistance The political world is full of gatekeepers, careerists, and bullies who maintain control through intimidation. Any movement--whether within the Democratic Party or outside of it--will face resistance from all sides. Centrist politicians who stand for nothing will fear-monger about "splitting the vote," while corporate media will dismiss such a movement as unrealistic. But history shows that bold, people-driven movements succeeded when they ran on principles and justice, and refused to back down to intimidation and threats. Signs of Hope: The People Are Already Leading Despite the failures of some elected Democrats, grassroots activism is making a real impact: ✅ Unionization efforts are at an all-time high, securing better wages and conditions ✅ Boycotts are working, forcing corporations to cut ties with extremists. ✅ State Attorneys General are successfully suing corrupt politicians and reversing cruel policies. ✅ Local organizers are flipping school boards and city councils. These wins prove that direct action, economic leverage, and legal strategies are working--even when Congress refuses to act. Change won't happen overnight. Whether we build a movement within the Democratic Party or create a new political force, we need a plan. The best approach is to start small, win, and then scale up. Pilot programs: Identify winnable races and back bold candidates. Local wins: Focus on city councils, state legislatures, and ballot initiatives. Expand nationally: Build credibility, public trust, and public financial support over time. This process could take years--maybe a decade. Unfortunately, there's no quick flip of a switch to stop the increasing right wing authoritarianism harming working people every single day. But without a long-term strategy, we are doomed to repeat the same mistakes. And while it will take time to build a justice based movement, the good news is that all the pieces are here and with us now. We have the ideas, the vision, and the people fed up with the status quo. Sadly, the Democratic Party's approval is in free fall, and Trumpism is gaining strength. We need to lead with vigor and consistency now, if we hope to uphold justice tomorrow and for the next generation. We wrote this because we hear you when you tell us you are pissed. Let's channel that anger into a thoughtful path forward, and form that promised more perfect Union, together. Join the Discussion Share your questions in the comments below and join and for a live discussion. . We are chatting on Substack Live tonight March 12 at 6:30pm EST, and on SiriusXM Channel 126 this Sunday March 16 at 10am EST. The people will lead--politicians will follow. Let's get to work and build this movement together. The fight to stave off fascism under this new regime is growing. I cannot do it alone. There's no doubt about what they're trying to do and the private equity sharks are licking their chops. Just see Musk's own words:
"I think logically we should privatize anything that can reasonably be privatized," Musk said at a Morgan Stanley-sponsored financial conference. "I think we should privatize the Post Office and Amtrak for example... We should privatize everything we possibly can."
Show the Postal Board of Governors that we've got their back to defend this vital public service, refuse Trump's illegal order, and save the Post Office >> [https://actionnetwork.org/letters/stop-trumps-illegal-usps-takeover?source=group-integrity-first-voter-action-project&referrer=group-integrity-first-voter-action-project&redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.everyaction.com%2F9bivrSvjFEim0QMMvgcQrA2]

Voter Action Project
Folks,
Donald Trump is attempting an illegal takeover of the United States Postal Service by firing the entire Postal Board of Governors and placing the USPS directly under the control of billionaire Trump donor Howard Lutnick, recently sworn in as Secretary of Commerce. Trump described it as a “ type of merger .”
But here’s the truth, the Postal Service is not a private business and it doesn’t belong to Trump or the White House, it belongs to the American people.
This isn't the first time we've faced such a threat. We've stopped Trump before, from privatization efforts in 2018 to attempted sabotage before the 2020 elections. Now we must stop Trump's unconstitutional power grab and keep the Postal Service in public hands, where it belongs.
Demand that the Postal Board of Governors to refuse Trump's illegal order, stand strong, stay on the job, and save the Post Office >> [https://actionnetwork.org/letters/stop-trumps-illegal-usps-takeover?source=group-integrity-first-voter-action-project&referrer=group-integrity-first-voter-action-project&redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.everyaction.com%2F9bivrSvjFEim0QMMvgcQrA2]
SIGN HERE NOW ⇨ [https://actionnetwork.org/letters/stop-trumps-illegal-usps-takeover?source=group-integrity-first-voter-action-project&referrer=group-integrity-first-voter-action-project&redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.everyaction.com%2F9bivrSvjFEim0QMMvgcQrA2]
This move is unconstitutional and blatantly illegal.
In 1970, Congress passed the Postal Reorganization Act , explicitly removing the Postal Service from presidential control . They established the USPS as an independent, self-funded public agency. Trump's executive order would blatantly violate the law and undermine the separation of powers essential to our democracy. The Postal Board of Governors must reject this unlawful attempt by refusing Trump's firing order, and stay on the job to fight back.
If Trump is successful, postal workers, seniors, and rural Americans will bear the brunt of the devastating consequences. Over 640,000 dedicated postal employees, including 73,000 veterans, will see their livelihoods jeopardized . Rural communities risk losing guaranteed delivery of medication, Social Security checks, ballots, and other essential mail.
Trump's illegal plan would pave the way for a possible privatization of our public postal system by chopping up USPS, selling off its parts, and putting profit margins over public service.
Together with our diverse coalition of labor unions, veterans, voting rights advocates, civil rights groups, and grassroots activists across the nation, we've protected our Postal Service and we can and will do it again.

Israel365 Action is the only slate completely dedicated to laying the groundwork for Jewish sovereignty in Judea and Samaria and ending the notion of a two-state solution. We must keep fighting for immigrant youth. | | | | | Peter — this is a major development. **_A mandate on DACA from the Fifth Court Circuit just went into effect._** **[While we welcome this decision, a lot of uncertainty lies ahead of us. United We Dream Action is poised to continue informing our communities and demanding a clear pathway to citizenship. Can you fuel our work with a $20 donation today?](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqv6GKGRKiD2A9cpAeztYplrPQtKgNRxJ4NxE8B81MzWIuSnA8P6J65-0mULYyLDWDXoKHHC5TgEOISlVWeuJuGggTglzP_ioIznsSKfpcBC-3pOIpJpH_CWw4rlKu8szq-5vxAqNFZA1_p0qTa8GfZK2p2WyWOs5g9xcD6i604irVXqE581otMgEGP7El6mqTr18yHqBnbmC1qfrisFlcP2s-co_pWtcDB3lNXQ92LV3gmhXvTRekG6tljWx5vAFtWmmBHklqSRyNsMHbF9kFLKlp1LfmnsuvQWE85Xb3MnHoBBPmjFTU-TJU7zPpCDtxH-P9vLKUvO4b0qQ84IrPjOzR8sbWGdkbRbXhZp77sSmWnEzI4mw8rWal6Vnp7s5SA0KkVtTOVzu7ARnZJnLJJcLJSYSRw80ktrafcAYbtDew/4eq/9ogp75QYR8GdJYEOpWThXg/h0/h001.0bPB3YAwMYTa4wPMvgxudVqM6Shhk--eGiiAo64INKo)**

Peter, this decision potentially reopens DACA applications for first-time applicants for the first time in _years_.
The Trump administration hasn’t issued official guidance, and no new applications have been processed yet. With so much uncertainty, we currently advise our community to speak with a lawyer or accredited legal service provider if you need support.
Ever since all first-time DACA applications were barred from being processed, immigrant youth and our allies have fought to defend our siblings, friends, and loved ones across the country who were left without protection from deportation. Yesterday’s development should be life-changing news for thousands of immigrants. However, we cannot trust Trump's Administration to follow the law and do the right thing.
We are under no illusions. Donald Trump will continue with his agenda to target as many people as possible with mass abductions and indefinite detention. We cannot deny the current administration’s ability to access and abuse personal data to target and detain DACA applicants — as well as the possibility that Trump could end DACA at any time.
Peter, the fight to protect our communities is not just taking place in the courts. It’s in the streets and will require all of us, immigrants and allies alike, to take action and secure a clear pathway to citizenship.
**Whatever comes next, we’re ready to mobilize in defense of our communities because**** _we are here to stay_****.** **[We will continue to update you as things change, but if you want to support our fight, please chip in any amount today:](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqv6GKGRKiD2A9cpAeztYplrPQtKgNRxJ4NxE8B81MzWIuSnA8P6J65-0mULYyLDWDXoKHHC5TgEOISlVWeuJuGg-_5gyXycAlo3nz0-v-2yhd9yBH_Kpsa-wuwIjPY9bBdMaA_AdCT1sISBki3mL3_SawGE7qHoXf9DpjRvKDHT0sfzJ0OLUZv5B7X7_K2ySmtYKJ41w3qCub43yFZ1JQs6128P-1HYmaWUM1OJUXlM1Kp9hcNSuPHGTm85Z-v8EvLByRhPkELsIylG-OQMz7yMRzt5EO6Ixq-lrS_r1OanKsAQuEJGnnMhDqAsSXM9UyPXdalLgtfhb0iFSBVqBfLoKGZMiai7ehZUzMbh0ZSH7uNN8jp0MvtSpIV3aERHoa6xgKe2ZMMeH2aaotJYaAVJ-LWUnMYgP0kLqHQ7oOZVZg/4eq/9ogp75QYR8GdJYEOpWThXg/h1/h001.PcOGENDWJvNhZYI_EQLS1vR7a_J1f6fJlj13A0PVkJQ)**

clean_body: We must keep fighting for immigrant youth. | | | | | Peter — this is a major development. A mandate on DACA from the Fifth Court Circuit just went into effect. Peter, this decision potentially reopens DACA applications for first-time applicants for the first time in years. The Trump administration hasn’t issued official guidance, and no new applications have been processed yet. With so much uncertainty, we currently advise our community to speak with a lawyer or accredited legal service provider if you need support. Ever since all first-time DACA applications were barred from being processed, immigrant youth and our allies have fought to defend our siblings, friends, and loved ones across the country who were left without protection from deportation. Yesterday’s development should be life-changing news for thousands of immigrants. However, we cannot trust Trump's Administration to follow the law and do the right thing. We are under no illusions. Donald Trump will continue with his agenda to target as many people as possible with mass abductions and indefinite detention. We cannot deny the current administration’s ability to access and abuse personal data to target and detain DACA applicants — as well as the possibility that Trump could end DACA at any time. Peter, the fight to protect our communities is not just taking place in the courts. It’s in the streets and will require all of us, immigrants and allies alike, to take action and secure a clear pathway to citizenship. Whatever comes next, we’re ready to mobilize in defense of our communities because we are here to stay. We can’t allow this unconstitutional targeting based on political speech. | | | [](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.X6XUC7u8ppFLNtMO_55SZlNseb7gEYIOhm_EWnhzEOZKmTtnV3k2h4V2x_O3H7rdW2az5rgktBwzxQ8Ml9Wgkmv85qW-UsBonL4KRa0bcNqdICU6T3NBDdNIZG7w7wEWH1cg5S-HZP03lX9hFk1Cd7uGAYjyUvMZs-6lnOeuoBM0-TgpKgFazf9GbnDlCOb9jvu-HQq_N1hRQY4TmcyNGBlU5cHEc9Dbs7NQX6HkEuQ8RfOJjqUBU8tMeKAtZ6f_/4eq/AkzyZ_YvR6Gz-yYbQXSIiA/h0/h001.8YOkRKG3lBG64ZB0zPQyJ7NFDU8_7YL1JqZzkvSHPmo)
---
Friend, I’m horrified by this weekend’s illegal abduction and detention of U.S. legal permanent resident Mahmoud Khalil. Without any warrants or charges, plainclothes immigration agents arrested him for exercising his First Amendment rights and participating in pro-Palestine student protests at Columbia University. Refusing to identify themselves, the agents even threatened to arrest his wife, a U.S. citizen who is eight months pregnant. Federal agents first told Khalil that the State Department revoked his student visa. When they were told that he was actually a legal permanent resident with a green card, the agents were confused but then said the State Department “revoked that, too.” They hung up on Khalil’s attorney who demanded a warrant. Then the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) effectively disappeared Khalil for days, denying him access to legal counsel and to family visitation. **These are illegal violations of Khalil’s constitutional rights to free speech and due process, and this is a threat to all Americans who engage in political protest.** Trump warned: “This is the first arrest of many to come,” saying he plans to imprison and deport more students involved in protests. We cannot be silent in the face of this lawless abuse of power. We cannot allow fascist targeting of people for expressing their political opinion. **We must keep ramping up public pressure to release Mahmoud Khalil.** **A federal judge temporarily blocked Khalil’s deportation until a court hearing TODAY.** **I led 13 of my colleagues in a letter demanding the Trump administration immediately release Khalil** —including Al Green, Jasmine Crockett, Nydia M. Valázquez, and more. **Will you join us?** [**Please add your name to join our call and demand Mahmoud Khalil’s immediate release from Department of Homeland Security (DHS) custody.**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm3-lsKVGAu82BQ6Uuc0Uv5OJRsSmyDM1poHCrLJw2C5g707b5KJr8hb86hTHoNRHQdTxXyk2hT3D8VEpV5egrjd7XKV4yUF7PkDzCYwec01MUZeF6_wJCeYRGd_t-2BFSZHZUosCvLviM5YsxIClrQwBeHf-4QY6hFXdLQJIHLdIUc_3gK7EbYZaJlMSizlxb3-L0KNTkV4jVTKjMc96PNN8_J5xGw4vCjy-5W88sEmfs0P3cnqC2BKniRmkfuGJCAJV9m9-9YXkXNam617ySsW3W2evPabipSgx1DCTmJGEcQ/4eq/AkzyZ_YvR6Gz-yYbQXSIiA/h1/h001.H-yZyY5hw2Uf4KlDdwj5TST0TtQZcTcxxz0YUCYO1K4) | [ADD YOUR NAME](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm3-lsKVGAu82BQ6Uuc0Uv5OJRsSmyDM1poHCrLJw2C5g707b5KJr8hb86hTHoNRHQdTxXyk2hT3D8VEpV5egrjd7aqBj4EuXUQU9CKCm4akdzGg79KJdUO8RFrlxXg8XdxtqV_4GwWJ4b-j-WOEgHcgEBnqgCBDwasUhAtM7fNLALb_LqF57A3jz1YqKQqcAGoODFvI2hELfo_ZDdnLGjzsU0xyuUlSEvpZ8UbtRxwBJQnvbHgHUxHKo6Wg9AVuCjPVbVruYPEU68S1BKCyemGr8vjZp026ZyZluujWUjx948Q/4eq/AkzyZ_YvR6Gz-yYbQXSIiA/h2/h001.G7S4ThEkkn9rKhc4PG-LrG0QY5ukMtO-jbTncofT3mo)
---
DHS only provided information about Khalil’s whereabouts after a New York court filed a legal petition to challenge his detention, revealing that DHS had transferred him over 1,300 miles from his home to an ICE facility in Louisiana. They have still not charged him with any crime. The American Civil Liberties Union has called these moves “unprecedented.”
Our Congressional letter not only demands Khalil’s immediate release, but also calls on the Department of Homeland Security to “immediately refrain from any further illegal arrests targeting constitutionally protected speech and activity.”
We will not let the Trump administration shred our constitutional rights to free speech and due process. The right to dissent is a foundation of democracy. Criminalizing protest is not only intended to silence the U.S. solidarity movement with Palestine, but is also a threat to all Americans who dare to speak out against our government.
Since last spring’s campus protests, when police arrested over 3,500 students across the country, universities have put in place new rules to suppress dissent, surveil students, and increase campus collaboration with law enforcement.
Now the new presidential administration could further endanger students with visas, the 13 million green card holders in our country, and even U.S. citizens. In a _New York Times_ article titled, “This is the greatest threat to free speech since the Red Scare,” Michelle Goldberg writes: "a government this willing to disregard the First Amendment is a danger to us all."
The article also quotes Margo Schlanger, a law professor who served in Obama’s administration as the DHS head of civil rights. Affirming that all people in this country have the same free speech protections as citizens, she said: “I teach constitutional law. And I’m freaking out.”
We must speak up—if Trump gets away with this, his administration will target more students, protesters, and people who disagree with him. We will resist this authoritarianism together.
[**Please sign on now to demand Mahmoud Khalil’s immediate release from DHS custody and speak out against the Trump administration’s illegal, unconstitutional, and unacceptable actions.**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm3-lsKVGAu82BQ6Uuc0Uv5OJRsSmyDM1poHCrLJw2C5g707b5KJr8hb86hTHoNRHQdTxXyk2hT3D8VEpV5egrjd7d5siRJtpAIjXup3NDruJH4CkygwEM4SEd2wBRvVjS5UZH8il7TCGuoh30RZ8ct7i425heTSA_jkaxvIDWFpwk-RvxXyG2hVvGBcImlGSvJxe8BgJknq9ivdl1YEXaqb7pFOx21ekaFbD2M0FSuoPNlNxhGKsilL50UZfrCY6R33c5sbqtp1wE2Ubmy-Pq444Qe6E5hOmi4U04mQWh6iNCw/4eq/AkzyZ_YvR6Gz-yYbQXSIiA/h3/h001.UP6-Hoa8T31pSzeU1TrPQcsl1w_Z4jvNI5c_gfyqksU)
Thank you for continuing to stand up for our rights and our shared humanity.
With you in this fight,
Rashida

name: Elissa Slotkin
subject: On The View this week
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ELISSA SLOTKIN FOR MICHIGAN
body:
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=2255%2E135344%2EweDV7M)

[](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-mar25.ecmY5i&refcode=em250312-1&refcode2=2255.135344.weDV7M&t=2&akid=2255%2E135344%2EweDV7M)
---
On Tuesday morning, I was on The View. If you didn’t get the chance to watch, [**you can catch it here**](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/3683?t=3&akid=2255%2E135344%2EweDV7M).
During the conversation, I talked about how Democrats need to be ruthless about what we prioritize: we can’t stand for everything because then we stand for nothing.
This last election, the American people made it clear that they are not happy with the status quo, but there’s a reasonable way and a reckless way to create change.
Donald Trump is looking, in all the couch cushions, for $6 trillion so that he can rewrite the tax code and give a real big benefit to some of the wealthiest in our country. And he’s going to make you pay in every part of your life - including your Social Security and Medicare.
[](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-mar25.ecmY5i&refcode=em250312-1&t=4&akid=2255%2E135344%2EweDV7M)
The hosts asked me what my top priority is, and it’s a no-brainer for me: the economy.
If people can’t afford the summer camp for their kids or to go on a vacation, they are less generous with their neighbors and it causes a feeling of desperation. That’s why, for me, the solid American Dream is still what we should all be working on.

"**Gov. Abbott wants a San Antonio Cyber Command. UTSA has a plan make that happen** ," Houston Chronicle's **Evan McDonald** -- "The University of Texas at San Antonio is set to play a pivotal role in transforming San Antonio into the central hub for Gov. **Greg Abbott 's **Texas Cyber Command, the university's president told the San Antonio Report on Tuesday.

UTSA's School of Data Science played host to a national summit focused on driving innovation in the cybersecurity field on Tuesday, welcoming parties from all over Texas and from Washington, D.C., to discuss why San Antonio is uniquely positioned to be this new hub for Texas.

During his State of the State address last month, Abbott named [the creation](https://substack.com/redirect/9ecaa6fd-e56b-4151-bed8-344d7ce4d322?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) of a Texas Cyber Command in San Antonio as one of his seven priority items, surprising some local leaders who said they hadn't heard this idea previously.

UTSA's President **Taylor Eighmy** was not among those taken by surprise, however.

In fact, discussions about the command have been ongoing for more than a year, he explained Tuesday.

"My team and I have been in close coordination with the governor's office about this new Texas Cyber Command agency that will be affiliated with UT San Antonio," he said. "The bill for that just got filed last night to authorize it ... and it's out for comment from members of the appropriate committees up in Austin," Eighmy added, referring to [Senate Bill 2176](https://substack.com/redirect/e7f4ca2d-e6f3-46c6-ac8c-53fadd49e3e2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
[BECOME A PAID SUBSCRIBER: $7/mo](https://substack.com/redirect/0b9a2048-fe60-4563-949c-ff7a5f37232e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
If the bill passes as is, Texas Cyber Command would be "a component institution of The University of Texas System," and would be "administratively attached to the University of Texas at San Antonio."

UTSA is well-positioned to lead this initiative, Eighmy said. In January 2023, UTSA opened the $91.8 million National Security Collaboration Center and School of Data Science in downtown San Antonio at 506 Dolorosa St., and in December, [the university revealed](https://substack.com/redirect/1d098d04-192d-4183-941e-837be9fcd332?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) plans to launch the College of AI, Cyber, and Computing, with an anticipated formal debut in fall 2025.
[BECOME A PAID SUBSCRIBER: $70/yr](https://substack.com/redirect/0b9a2048-fe60-4563-949c-ff7a5f37232e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Eighmy suggested Tuesday that the university plans to lobby for more funding to support the Abbott-blessed effort.

"We have some special requests in place that are going to support this new College of AI, Cyber, and Computing, and that's still in play," Eighmy said. "There's a lot of activity up in the capitol, and we're advocating for all sorts of things. We have a lot of work to do."

The college will house 6,000 students and staff at the university's downtown San Antonio campus, contributing to downtown's development, Eighmy said.

San Antonio's economic landscape, which is bolstered by the presence of the NSA and Department of Defense, helps position the city to be a major cybersecurity hub, he added.

Eighmy is one of the many reasons UTSA was selected for the summit, said **Deborah Wince-Smith** , president and CEO of the Council on Competitiveness. The Council is a non-profit organization based in Washington, D.C. with the goal of increasing the United States' economic competitiveness in the global marketplace. His role as a commissioner on the National Commission of Innovation and Competitiveness within the Council on Competitiveness was integral in the university's selection, Wince-Smith added.

"San Antonio is really ground zero in America for our cybersecurity infrastructure with the Air Force, the Joint Base, and many other infrastructures here," she said. "We're thrilled to bring all these people together to discuss this critical topic for the U.S., competitiveness and national security."" UTSA has a plan make that happen ," Houston Chronicle's Evan McDonald -- "The University of Texas at San Antonio is set to play a pivotal role in transforming San Antonio into the central hub for Gov. Greg Abbott 's Texas Cyber Command, the university's president told the San Antonio Report on Tuesday. UTSA's School of Data Science played host to a national summit focused on driving innovation in the cybersecurity field on Tuesday, welcoming parties from all over Texas and from Washington, D.C., to discuss why San Antonio is uniquely positioned to be this new hub for Texas. During his State of the State address last month, Abbott named of a Texas Cyber Command in San Antonio as one of his seven priority items, surprising some local leaders who said they hadn't heard this idea previously. UTSA's President Taylor Eighmy was not among those taken by surprise, however. In fact, discussions about the command have been ongoing for more than a year, he explained Tuesday. "My team and I have been in close coordination with the governor's office about this new Texas Cyber Command agency that will be affiliated with UT San Antonio," he said. "The bill for that just got filed last night to authorize it ... and it's out for comment from members of the appropriate committees up in Austin," Eighmy added, referring to . If the bill passes as is, Texas Cyber Command would be "a component institution of The University of Texas System," and would be "administratively attached to the University of Texas at San Antonio." UTSA is well-positioned to lead this initiative, Eighmy said. In January 2023, UTSA opened the $91.8 million National Security Collaboration Center and School of Data Science in downtown San Antonio at 506 Dolorosa St., and in December, plans to launch the College of AI, Cyber, and Computing, with an anticipated formal debut in fall 2025. Eighmy suggested Tuesday that the university plans to lobby for more funding to support the Abbott-blessed effort. "We have some special requests in place that are going to support this new College of AI, Cyber, and Computing, and that's still in play," Eighmy said. "There's a lot of activity up in the capitol, and we're advocating for all sorts of things. We have a lot of work to do." The college will house 6,000 students and staff at the university's downtown San Antonio campus, contributing to downtown's development, Eighmy said. San Antonio's economic landscape, which is bolstered by the presence of the NSA and Department of Defense, helps position the city to be a major cybersecurity hub, he added. Eighmy is one of the many reasons UTSA was selected for the summit, said Deborah Wince-Smith , president and CEO of the Council on Competitiveness. The Council is a non-profit organization based in Washington, D.C. with the goal of increasing the United States' economic competitiveness in the global marketplace. His role as a commissioner on the National Commission of Innovation and Competitiveness within the Council on Competitiveness was integral in the university's selection, Wince-Smith added. "San Antonio is really ground zero in America for our cybersecurity infrastructure with the Air Force, the Joint Base, and many other infrastructures here," she said. "We're thrilled to bring all these people together to discuss this critical topic for the U.S., competitiveness and national security."" * **TOP NEWS**

"**Gov. Abbott wants a San Antonio Cyber Command. UTSA has a plan make that happen** ," Houston Chronicle's **Evan McDonald** -- "The University of Texas at San Antonio is set to play a pivotal role in transforming San Antonio into the central hub for Gov. **Greg Abbott 's **Texas Cyber Command, the university's president told the San Antonio Report on Tuesday.

UTSA's School of Data Science played host to a national summit focused on driving innovation in the cybersecurity field on Tuesday, welcoming parties from all over Texas and from Washington, D.C., to discuss why San Antonio is uniquely positioned to be this new hub for Texas.

During his State of the State address last month, Abbott named [the creation](https://substack.com/redirect/9bab4039-e8ac-4190-8051-443a63eb651b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) of a Texas Cyber Command in San Antonio as one of his seven priority items, surprising some local leaders who said they hadn't heard this idea previously.

UTSA's President **Taylor Eighmy** was not among those taken by surprise, however.

In fact, discussions about the command have been ongoing for more than a year, he explained Tuesday.

"My team and I have been in close coordination with the governor's office about this new Texas Cyber Command agency that will be affiliated with UT San Antonio," he said. "The bill for that just got filed last night to authorize it ... and it's out for comment from members of the appropriate committees up in Austin," Eighmy added, referring to [Senate Bill 2176](https://substack.com/redirect/5904df90-1a98-4555-9c23-0c481081f7fc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
[BECOME A PAID SUBSCRIBER: $7/mo](https://substack.com/redirect/8e394312-f6d1-4126-99ea-ab3edc0cc079?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
If the bill passes as is, Texas Cyber Command would be "a component institution of The University of Texas System," and would be "administratively attached to the University of Texas at San Antonio."

UTSA is well-positioned to lead this initiative, Eighmy said. In January 2023, UTSA opened the $91.8 million National Security Collaboration Center and School of Data Science in downtown San Antonio at 506 Dolorosa St., and in December, [the university revealed](https://substack.com/redirect/ab2079d4-3246-46ca-8a9d-c726bb363885?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) plans to launch the College of AI, Cyber, and Computing, with an anticipated formal debut in fall 2025.
[BECOME A PAID SUBSCRIBER: $70/yr](https://substack.com/redirect/8e394312-f6d1-4126-99ea-ab3edc0cc079?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Eighmy suggested Tuesday that the university plans to lobby for more funding to support the Abbott-blessed effort.

"We have some special requests in place that are going to support this new College of AI, Cyber, and Computing, and that's still in play," Eighmy said. "There's a lot of activity up in the capitol, and we're advocating for all sorts of things. We have a lot of work to do."

The college will house 6,000 students and staff at the university's downtown San Antonio campus, contributing to downtown's development, Eighmy said.

San Antonio's economic landscape, which is bolstered by the presence of the NSA and Department of Defense, helps position the city to be a major cybersecurity hub, he added.

Eighmy is one of the many reasons UTSA was selected for the summit, said **Deborah Wince-Smith** , president and CEO of the Council on Competitiveness. The Council is a non-profit organization based in Washington, D.C. with the goal of increasing the United States' economic competitiveness in the global marketplace. His role as a commissioner on the National Commission of Innovation and Competitiveness within the Council on Competitiveness was integral in the university's selection, Wince-Smith added.

"San Antonio is really ground zero in America for our cybersecurity infrastructure with the Air Force, the Joint Base, and many other infrastructures here," she said. "We're thrilled to bring all these people together to discuss this critical topic for the U.S., competitiveness and national security."" UTSA has a plan make that happen ," Houston Chronicle's Evan McDonald -- "The University of Texas at San Antonio is set to play a pivotal role in transforming San Antonio into the central hub for Gov. Greg Abbott 's Texas Cyber Command, the university's president told the San Antonio Report on Tuesday. UTSA's School of Data Science played host to a national summit focused on driving innovation in the cybersecurity field on Tuesday, welcoming parties from all over Texas and from Washington, D.C., to discuss why San Antonio is uniquely positioned to be this new hub for Texas. During his State of the State address last month, Abbott named of a Texas Cyber Command in San Antonio as one of his seven priority items, surprising some local leaders who said they hadn't heard this idea previously. UTSA's President Taylor Eighmy was not among those taken by surprise, however. In fact, discussions about the command have been ongoing for more than a year, he explained Tuesday. "My team and I have been in close coordination with the governor's office about this new Texas Cyber Command agency that will be affiliated with UT San Antonio," he said. "The bill for that just got filed last night to authorize it ... and it's out for comment from members of the appropriate committees up in Austin," Eighmy added, referring to . If the bill passes as is, Texas Cyber Command would be "a component institution of The University of Texas System," and would be "administratively attached to the University of Texas at San Antonio." UTSA is well-positioned to lead this initiative, Eighmy said. In January 2023, UTSA opened the $91.8 million National Security Collaboration Center and School of Data Science in downtown San Antonio at 506 Dolorosa St., and in December, plans to launch the College of AI, Cyber, and Computing, with an anticipated formal debut in fall 2025. Eighmy suggested Tuesday that the university plans to lobby for more funding to support the Abbott-blessed effort. "We have some special requests in place that are going to support this new College of AI, Cyber, and Computing, and that's still in play," Eighmy said. "There's a lot of activity up in the capitol, and we're advocating for all sorts of things. We have a lot of work to do." The college will house 6,000 students and staff at the university's downtown San Antonio campus, contributing to downtown's development, Eighmy said. San Antonio's economic landscape, which is bolstered by the presence of the NSA and Department of Defense, helps position the city to be a major cybersecurity hub, he added. Eighmy is one of the many reasons UTSA was selected for the summit, said Deborah Wince-Smith , president and CEO of the Council on Competitiveness. The Council is a non-profit organization based in Washington, D.C. with the goal of increasing the United States' economic competitiveness in the global marketplace. His role as a commissioner on the National Commission of Innovation and Competitiveness within the Council on Competitiveness was integral in the university's selection, Wince-Smith added. "San Antonio is really ground zero in America for our cybersecurity infrastructure with the Air Force, the Joint Base, and many other infrastructures here," she said. "We're thrilled to bring all these people together to discuss this critical topic for the U.S., competitiveness and national security.""
