UTSA has a plan make that happen ,” Houston Chronicle's Evan McDonald — “The University of Texas at San Antonio is set to play a pivotal role in transforming San Antonio into the central hub for Gov. Greg Abbott’s Texas Cyber Command, the university’s president told the San Antonio Report on Tuesday. UTSA’s School of Data Science played host to a national summit focused on driving innovation in the cybersecurity field on Tuesday, welcoming parties from all over Texas and from Washington, D.C., to discuss why San Antonio is uniquely positioned to be this new hub for Texas. During his State of the State address last month, Abbott named of a Texas Cyber Command in San Antonio as one of his seven priority items, surprising some local leaders who said they hadn’t heard this idea previously. UTSA’s President Taylor Eighmy was not among those taken by surprise, however. In fact, discussions about the command have been ongoing for more than a year, he explained Tuesday. “My team and I have been in close coordination with the governor’s office about this new Texas Cyber Command agency that will be affiliated with UT San Antonio,” he said. “The bill for that just got filed last night to authorize it ... and it’s out for comment from members of the appropriate committees up in Austin,” Eighmy added, referring to . » If the bill passes as is, Texas Cyber Command would be “a component institution of The University of Texas System,” and would be “administratively attached to the University of Texas at San Antonio.” UTSA is well-positioned to lead this initiative, Eighmy said. In January 2023, UTSA opened the $91.8 million National Security Collaboration Center and School of Data Science in downtown San Antonio at 506 Dolorosa St., and in December, plans to launch the College of AI, Cyber, and Computing, with an anticipated formal debut in fall 2025. » Eighmy suggested Tuesday that the university plans to lobby for more funding to support the Abbott-blessed effort. “We have some special requests in place that are going to support this new College of AI, Cyber, and Computing, and that’s still in play,” Eighmy said. “There’s a lot of activity up in the capitol, and we’re advocating for all sorts of things. We have a lot of work to do.” The college will house 6,000 students and staff at the university’s downtown San Antonio campus, contributing to downtown’s development, Eighmy said. San Antonio’s economic landscape, which is bolstered by the presence of the NSA and Department of Defense, helps position the city to be a major cybersecurity hub, he added. Eighmy is one of the many reasons UTSA was selected for the summit, said Deborah Wince-Smith , president and CEO of the Council on Competitiveness. The Council is a non-profit organization based in Washington, D.C. with the goal of increasing the United States’ economic competitiveness in the global marketplace. His role as a commissioner on the National Commission of Innovation and Competitiveness within the Council on Competitiveness was integral in the university’s selection, Wince-Smith added. ”San Antonio is really ground zero in America for our cybersecurity infrastructure with the Air Force, the Joint Base, and many other infrastructures here,” she said. “We’re thrilled to bring all these people together to discuss this critical topic for the U.S., competitiveness and national security.”" | FREE SUBSCRIPTIONS HAVE ENDED : As of July 11, 2022, we have moved to a paywall for free subscribers. Dear Friends and Supporters,
Recent events have highlighted a concerning disconnect between the administration's actions and the pressing needs of everyday Americans. Just yesterday, President Trump hosted Elon Musk at the White House, showcasing Tesla vehicles and announcing his intention to purchase one, despite the fact that he cannot drive. Help me reconnect our government to its constituents ; We only have 20 days to get it together.
While this display aimed to support Musk and Tesla, it comes at a time when the stock market is experiencing significant volatility. In just 50 days, approximately $2.7 trillion has been wiped off the market value of major tech companies, including Tesla, due to turbulent U.S. markets; Markets that have become uncertain because of Trump’s own actions.
[https://d15k2d11r6t6rl.cloudfront.net/public/users/Integrators/04eaa6b2-88f4-43b4-b978-7bb0708f5838/5462546D765A664935665743687157464767775A476A686C7A6B4D42455434797854364D4F716B694965777A695A747476452B39625153453433505864554B34/editor_images/Screenshot%202025-03-12%20at%2010.52.27%E2%80%AFAM.png]
We have seen Trump shift from fully anti-electric cars, to all of a sudden loving Musk and his brand. The shift in and of itself is rooted in the wrong reasons and has sparked uncertainty , as well as shown Trump is fully disconnected from American struggles.
As your advocate, I am committed to addressing these issues head-on. We need leadership that prioritizes the needs of all citizens over symbolic gestures. It's imperative to focus on policies that ensure economic stability, protect essential services, and safeguard our environment. Together, we can work towards a government that truly serves its people and addresses the real challenges we face. I urge you to stay informed and engaged via this campaign in order to get our government back on track.

In a flagrant example that demonstrates the urgency to crack down
on reckless government spending, the federal agency that runs the
nation’s scandal-plagued food stamp program gave a public
historically black university over half a million dollars to study
menstrual cycles in transgender men and people with masculine gender
identities. The U.S. Department of Agriculture (USDA), long rocked by
fraud and corruption in its $112.8 billion food stamp program, awarded
the $600,000 grant to Southern University A&M College in Baton
Rouge, Louisiana last spring and the money is scheduled to flow
through the spring of 2027. After explaining that a woman will have a
monthly menstrual cycle for about 40 years of her life, the USDA grant
document states that “it is also important to recognize that
transgender men and people with masculine gender identities, intersex
and non-binary persons may also menstruate.”

**Every campaign sign I’ve had since 2016 has said “Lower Taxes” on it.**
I’ve delivered on that promise, helping to expand the Child Tax Credit and working on bringing millions back to Jersey for essentials like firetrucks, new roads, and clean drinking water. **I meant it then, and I mean it now.**

Our state deserves a leader who’ll make life easier for young people, families, seniors, and small business owners. _**We need a Governor who will always stand up for Jersey values — not a far-right agenda.**_

**I’m ready to go on offense to protect our state, our Jersey Values, and the great people who live here, but I can’t do it without your help. There are no off years. | | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/103731792/533063336/-201694504?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzY1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyOTAwYmM4OC02MWZmLWVmMTEtOTBjZC0wMDIyNDgyYTlmYjciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=GnmlC8Cyw-g0Q-IIWoUoQ_vLIRDVfn0B1y1OiAn_O9I=&emci=c93fe47c-e2fa-ef11-90cd-0022482a9fb7&emdi=2900bc88-61ff-ef11-90cd-0022482a9fb7&ceid=9494239)

| | **Today marks Equal Pay Day, a day that serves as a reminder of the persistent gender pay gap in the United States.** March 12 represents how far into the following year the average woman would need to work to earn the same amount of money her male counterparts work in the same role. That date goes even deeper into the calendar year for women of color. On average, Black women earn only 63 cents and Hispanic women just 55 cents for every dollar earned by white men. **This intersectionality compounds the economic disparities faced by marginalized communities, exacerbating systemic inequities.** Pay inequality is perpetuated by various factors, including gender bias in hiring and promotion, occupational segregation, and lack of transparency in salary negotiations. Women, on average, earn just 82 cents for every dollar earned by men, with the gap even wider for certain groups. **The solution is simple: equal pay for equal work.** How do we get there? By raising awareness, advocating for policies like pay transparency and anti-discrimination measures, and supporting initiatives that promote equal pay, and hold employers accountable to ensure fair compensation — regardless of gender identity. **In Congress, I have cosponsored several pieces of legislation seeking to establish equal pay for equal work, including legislation that would:**
* Raise the federal minimum wage to $15 per hour and tie future increases to the median hourly wage;
* Ensure people are paid based on their skills and experience, not their gender;
* Allow lower-wage workers to request for flexibility of their schedules without retaliation; and
* Help end discrimination against pregnant women and parents in the workplace.

Last month, I did something I don’t normally do: a “stitch” on TikTok replying to someone expressing despair about Trump’s attacks on the foundations of our democracy.

I am a proud digitally-challenged Millennial, and not especially skilled at social media influencing or content creation. When I jumped into this conversation, it felt unnatural and a little awkward. (_Did I mention that I’m a Millennial?_) **
But to be honest, I am just upset.** I’m frustrated, scared, and feeling deeply uncertain about _basic things that until recently we could take for granted_ like the ability to control my own body, to make my own choice about starting a family (or not), children having protection from preventable and devastating diseases like measles and polio, and being free to protest and disagree politically without the threat of violence or retribution...to name just a few.

So when I started sharing my thoughts on TikTok, I was very much out of my comfort zone — yet because the message was simple and sincere, it touched a nerve.

Our organizing team, partnered with Philly Thrive and other organizations, have been applying pressure. We are calling on City Council to support the Safe Healthy Homes platform by:
* funding $10 million to licenses & inspections for a pilot proactive inspections program to support renters, and
* $10 million for Philadelphia Energy Authority’s Built to Last home repair program to support low-income homeowners.

Multiple news outlets reported hundreds of Philly tenants living without heat this winter, an entire Philly senior housing complex at Brith Sholom in a state of dangerous disrepair, and the tragic death of a 12-year-old girl that her mother attributes to a landlord’s neglect and Philly’s lax oversight.

Individuals or federal non-multicandidate PACs may contribute up to $322,100. Such contributions shall be allocated in the following order:

Any contributor may designate his or her contribution to a specific participant Committee to the extent permitted by FECA. Federal law requires us to use our best efforts to collect and report the name, mailing address, occupation, and name of employer of each individual whose aggregate contributions exceed $200 in an election cycle or calendar year, as applicable.

My situation is in your hands, Fellow American. I'm writing today to give you an update and to make a humble plea. _Look - this is from the bottom of my heart, so _please_ read this message to the end._ My team and I put together a historic win in 2021 to help flip all three of Virginia's highest offices red. Ever since becoming Lt. Governor, I've been logging big wins for my friends, neighbors, and every fellow Virginian. Now, I'm running for Governor so we can continue to keep up the amazing work we've been doing here in the Commonwealth and make history again. **But right now I have a few _SERIOUS_ challenges:**
---
**I was _legally_ barred from accepting even a dime in support of my campaign while I was in the Virginia legislative session.** But my Democrat opponent, Abigail Spanberger, was fundraising _**BIG TIME**_ while I was working hard in our capital. **Seriously** _**, a far-Left group injected $500K into Abigail Spanberger 's campaign coffers and there wasn't a thing I could do in response!**_
---
Now Spanberger has an _ENORMOUS_ fundraising advantage, Fellow American. Polls show this race is tied, but Spanberger has a serious cash advantage._If we don 't make up the difference, our conservative mission _will_ be cut short. _ **Today, I 'm making a plea to you as a Christian, a mother, and a Marine; _please send in any amount you can spare to support my campaign!_**
---

The rapid downfall of Tesla stock is one of the most dramatic crashes of a formerly stable and successful company in recent memory.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/92f18ccf-66b0-474e-a1e0-5b206195c272?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

On some levels, this is incredibly disappointing.
As a climate scientist who sits on a state advisory board for the Maryland clean energy transition, I want electric cars to succeed.
Elon Musk's flippant, flamboyant and fallacious comments and behavior have triggered global boycotts of companies where Musk owns a controlling interest, including Tesla.
To salvage the dying brand, Musk has enlisted the entire right-wing, extremist ecosphere as brand ambassadors for Tesla.
For years, Tesla's customer base has tilted heavily toward liberals, made mostly of those with advanced education in the higher income brackets.
Once the most popular vehicle brand for the environmentally-conscience consumer, Musk's overt support for Nazism has driven much of his base away in the last year.
And the effects are global.
In Europe, Tesla sales [were down 50% ](https://substack.com/redirect/8ddf84ce-1cf5-43d8-953b-1dcb23b59b23?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)in January 2025 compared to the same time the previous year -- despite [recent policies to incentivize the purchase of electric vehicles](https://substack.com/redirect/f6940d13-cbb5-4ac4-80e0-9c1823dbc1ef?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
Germany -- Europe's largest EV market -- saw a [30% increase in all EV sales](https://substack.com/redirect/daa77b6e-f4a3-4c77-974e-2f1afb1902e1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) over the last year, while Tesla's sales dropped 70% during the same period.
How did the unpopular populist respond to his company's rapid descent?
He paid some right-wing people to showcase his cars.
Donald Trump [claims](https://substack.com/redirect/04000dc4-66ad-44e8-9940-afab3b5f6860?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) he recently bought a Tesla Model S -- following a show-room style publicity stunt from the White House grounds.
I say claims because, apparently, he hasn't paid for it yet.
Even though Trump [does not drive](https://substack.com/redirect/78e5756b-8e2c-4511-b61c-1b9579dae14f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and at more 300 pounds likely can't fit into the notoriously cramped Model S, the stunt was the start of a far-right push to stop falling Tesla sales and salvage the collapsing stock price.
Then Sean Hannity pulled the same stunt - claiming on X(itter) to have purchased the same model that Trump promised he'd pay for.
Hannity also [falsely asserted ](https://substack.com/redirect/761a15a6-7857-472b-bb24-93dd2f3fd287?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)that "Tesla is the MOST American made car in the country!"
Tesla is a company, not a car.
Hannity bought the Tesla Model S, which is not the most "American-made car."
The Model Y is.
In fact, the Model S ranks #4, behind the Honda Passport and the Volkswagen ID.4. And the ID.4 is electric...

name: Katie Porter
subject: Here’s why you should donate early
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Katie Porter for Governor 2026
body:
# [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/21486?t=1&akid=39528%2E3422442%2E_bGr4W)
Derek, it’s Day 2 of my campaign to be California’s next governor, and I don’t just want to ask you for money—I want to explain exactly how early donations matter.
Here are three reasons why campaigns like when you donate early:
1. **They help campaigns plan.** Having resources early on gives a better idea of what we can spend on ads, events, voter contact, and other things we need to win. When we look at whether to hire that organizer or travel to that community, we keep fundraising numbers in mind.

2. **They build momentum.** Pundits and others use campaign donation numbers to judge whether campaigns are viable. A strong early fundraising number suggests that our campaign is one to take seriously, which will help us earn more support.

3. **They put special interests on notice.** Special interests are less likely to mess with us if they see a groundswell of grassroots support. Meeting—or even exceeding—our early fundraising targets makes outside groups think twice about spending in this race.

I know how hard Americans work for their money, which is why I’m asking you to chip in now when your dollar goes the furthest to help us win. I wouldn’t be asking if it wasn’t important.
**[So please, will you donate $5 today to help get this campaign off the ground?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_kp_20250312_2_ak?refcode=em20250312-39528&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=39528_3422442__bGr4W&akid=39528%2E3422442%2E_bGr4W)**

Friend,
Today is National Working Moms Day — a day that resonates deeply with me. As I reflect on my journey, I am reminded of why I ran for office and who I am fighting for: the single working women and mothers in the Bay Area, just like my mother and me.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lateefah-for-congress-uplift?refcode=x_250312_workingmomsday_act [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lateefah-for-congress-uplift?refcode=x_250312_workingmomsday_act]
I was raised by a single mother in San Francisco’s Western Addition neighborhood. Then, at 18, I became a young single mother myself. I quickly learned that the government doesn’t always work for families like mine.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lateefah-for-congress-uplift?refcode=x_250312_workingmomsday_act [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lateefah-for-congress-uplift?refcode=x_250312_workingmomsday_act] https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lateefah-for-congress-uplift?refcode=x_250312_workingmomsday_act [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lateefah-for-congress-uplift?refcode=x_250312_workingmomsday_act]
Often, I had to bring my daughter to class due to lack of childcare, a struggle many single mothers face daily. Being a single mother meant I had to work twice as hard to give my daughter the same opportunities as her peers.
Right now, Republicans are actively working to gut the very programs that working moms depend on —childcare assistance, paid family leave, and affordable healthcare, just to name a few. They want to make it even harder for moms to provide for their families, all while handing tax breaks to billionaires. I refuse to let that happen.
Cause let’s face it: Donald Trump isn’t working for my mother, and he’s not working for yours either.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lateefah-for-congress-uplift?refcode=x_250312_workingmomsday_act [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lateefah-for-congress-uplift?refcode=x_250312_workingmomsday_act]
That’s why I’ve spent 25 years fighting for women like us—organizing, advocating, and ensuring our voices are heard. Today, I live with my youngest daughter while my eldest just graduated from law school. My journey has been challenging but powerful, and it has only strengthened my resolve to fight for justice.
Parents deserve someone in Congress who knows what it’s like to sprint from the end of a shift to the pickup line, or to answer emails while making tomorrow’s PB&J. While parents fight for their kids every day, I’ll be fighting for parents—I’ll be fighting for the working mothers.
In honor of National Working Moms Day, will you stand with me? Every contribution helps us build a movement for real change. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lateefah-for-congress-uplift?refcode=x_250312_workingmomsday_act]

The proposed Republican cuts to the Medicaid budget will have a devastating impact on the nursing homes here in Rhode Island.

subject: We will fight Republican cuts to Medicaid.

https://secure.actblue.com/donate/q12025-uplift?refcode=X_250312_comedicaid_act [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/q12025-uplift?refcode=X_250312_comedicaid_act]
Team,
Medicaid is a foundational piece of our healthcare system, providing healthcare coverage to 1.2 million Coloradans. Right now, Republicans are working to slash funding for Medicaid to fund another tax giveaway for the wealthiest Americans and corporations.
So many of our communities—especially our rural communities—will suffer if Republicans are successful in their efforts.
https://www.cpr.org/2025/03/08/medicaid-cuts-rural-hospitals-risk-of-closure/ [https://www.cpr.org/2025/03/08/medicaid-cuts-rural-hospitals-risk-of-closure/]
Over the past two decades, nearly 200 rural hospitals have shut down nationwide. If Trump and the GOP pass their plan, rural Colorado hospitals—that struggle enough as it is—could be at risk of closing.
In fact, if they cut Medicaid funding by a third, 48,000 rural residents and 140,000 children in Colorado could lose their healthcare and 20% of seniors could lose their nursing home care. In total, Trump and Republicans are putting almost 400,000 Coloradans at risk of losing their health insurance.
All this unnecessary hardship for working Colorado families so Republicans can give the wealthiest and the biggest corporations another tax cut.
The Republican plan is not only wrong on a moral level—it will harm Colorado’s working families, rural communities, and children.
Michael, alongside Senate Democrats, is putting up a fight to make sure Republicans don't get away with ripping off working Coloradans. He could use your backup. Team, can you join us? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/q12025-uplift?refcode=X_250312_comedicaid_act]

name: Barack Obama
subject: Hope
body:
The best way to not feel hopeless is to get up and do something.
---
Derek, Living in a democracy is about recognizing that our point of view won't always win out, but continuing to fight for the change we believe in. Since the last election, the foundational principles of our democracy have been challenged, and it would be easy to give in to fear and despair. But the change we seek — the change we need — will not come if we wait for some other person or some other time. The best way to make a difference is to get up and do something. Don't wait for the next election. Go out and make a difference right now. Because through your action, you will fill others with hope. And you might just fill yourself with hope. Today, I am asking you to do something that will give Democrats across the country hope that the next election will be different. [I am asking you to contribute $5, $50, or whatever you can afford to the Democratic National Committee today. name: Adam Schiff
subject: Taking the time to answer some of your questions
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR AND AUTHORIZED BY SCHIFF FOR SENATE
body:
[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/62?t=1001&akid=8356%2E5257348%2EhTgUJz ]Adam Schiff for Senate

Hi Derek,

As you probably know, there’s a lot going on in Washington right now. But
amidst all of the chaos, I wanted to make sure I set aside a moment to say
thank you.

You’ve responded to our requests for help at every fundraising deadline
and every big moment.

I couldn’t be prouder of this team or more appreciative of your continued
support and generosity, Derek,
so thank you. I couldn’t do this work
without you.

I also wanted to take some time to answer just a few of the many
thoughtful questions members of this team have sent me. In case you missed
it, my team and I kicked off our Ask Adam series to give folks like you
the opportunity to submit any questions you might have about my work in
the Senate ([ https://act.adamschiff.com/signup/engagement-202502-ask-adam/?t=1004&akid=8356%2E5257348%2EhTgUJz ]share your questions here!).

So without further ado ...

Nicole from California wrote “The Trump administration has clearly
demonstrated that they will not act in good faith. What steps do Democrats
plan to take outside of business as usual to deal with this power grab?”

We can’t treat this as business as usual. We have to do several things,
and do them well — oversight, legislation, litigation, communication, and
mobilization.

We need to do hard oversight, and not just when the TV cameras are
rolling. We can do that by uncovering information and exposing it — which
can force them to abandon plans. Part of this effort has included
encouraging whistleblowers to come forward — and they have, greatly
facilitating our ability to expose corruption and wrongdoing. We are also
using every procedural tool at our disposal to block their power grabs and
uncover what they’re doing. The slower they go, the less they can break.

We need to legislate to try to stop the worst abuses and force Republicans
to defend what they’re trying to do. Even though we’re in the minority, we
can still introduce bills to block the worst abuses, put Republicans on
record, and force them to defend their actions — like their push to cut
Medicaid, defund Social Security, and raise taxes on working families
while handing massive giveaways to billionaires. If they want to gut
programs that millions rely on, they need to own that in broad daylight.

We need to litigate in the courts to stop the many illegal and
unconstitutional actions Trump and his cronies are undertaking. While
Trump signs executive orders meant to create chaos and headlines, we’re
working to file legal challenges that stop them from taking effect. There
are already 20+ lawsuits challenging his most extreme moves — like his
attempts to freeze federal funding and gut agencies from the inside. And
we have had considerable success with this litigation.

And we must better communicate, not only by sharpening our message but
also by broadening the use of digital media and appearing on podcasts that
expand our progressive reach. My YouTube channel is now the most highly
watched of any member of Congress, and we are very active on all the other
platforms as well, getting millions of views and mushrooming our
engagement, perhaps the largest of any elected official.

Finally, we can mobilize — that is where you come in. We can take to the
streets and the national parks, we can show up at town halls and
roundtables, we can make our voices heard and amplify our own opinions and
the views of others. We must all engage to save our democracy.

Carol from Florida wrote “Adam, I am a senior citizen and rely on my
Social Security to get me through the month. Should I be worried that they
are going to take that away from me?”

Simply put, yes.

Just last week, Elon Musk — who, let's remember, is Donald Trump’s top
advisor and actor through DOGE — suggested he wanted to privatize Social
Security and called it a “Ponzi scheme.” Then, this week, his hand-picked
acting administrator began mass layoffs which will affect the ability of
the agency to do its critical work.

Listen, I’m going to fight like hell to keep this benefit for seniors
which they have earned. Because it’s their money and because it has been
an enormously successful program that helps people retire with dignity.
What’s more, the only reason Trump and Musk want to make changes to Social
Security is to find more money for their obscene tax cuts for millionaires
and billionaires.

And I’m confident that this is a fight that we will win — if the GOP is
dumb enough to pick it. I will never stop fighting to protect your Social
Security. You earned it. You paid into it. And I will do everything in my
power to make sure it’s there for you, and for generations to come.

Leslie from California wrote “I would like to know your recommendation of
the most effective ways citizens can push back on the illegal activities
of the current administration. I am concerned about our democracy, and
want to participate in saving it.”

Donald Trump and his administration want you to be afraid and to be cowed
into silence and inaction. One of the most important things you can do is
resist the urge to feel overwhelmed. That’s what they want. The chaos you
see — the executive orders, the purges of career government employees, the
attacks on federal agencies — is deliberate. It’s designed to make people
feel paralyzed as if nothing we do matters. That is a lie. The truth is:
we outnumber them. And when we take collective action, we can slow down,
and even stop their most dangerous efforts. After that, here are some of
the most important things you can do:

(1) Call and write your Representatives – yes, this works! Don’t assume
your member of Congress is voting the way you want them to; they need to
hear from you. Demand they block Trump’s unqualified appointees and fight
back against his budget cuts.

(2) Support local efforts to protect democracy. Get involved with groups
that are mobilizing at the local level to protect voting rights, support
immigrant communities, and flip Republican seats. This can be as small as
finding a local candidate to make calls for or contribute to. This work
really matters.

(3) Engage in elections at every level. Trump and his allies are watching
to see if we mobilize. We have special elections coming up. They may seem
small, but every race is a chance to build power and momentum for 2026.
Get involved, volunteer, and help elect leaders who will fight back.

The bottom line is that this administration wants us to believe that what
they’re doing is inevitable. It’s not.

Every person like you who’s donating time, energy, and resources helps
hold the Trump administration accountable and slow down their attempts to
break the system. It also builds real community and power, and that’s the
work that moves us forward.

families off. Don’t get bogged down by their attempts. We need you in the

clean_body: [ ]Adam Schiff for Senate Hi Derek, As you probably know, there’s a lot going on in Washington right now. But amidst all of the chaos, I wanted to make sure I set aside a moment to say thank you. You’ve responded to our requests for help at every fundraising deadline and every big moment. I couldn’t be prouder of this team or more appreciative of your continued support and generosity, Derek, so thank you. I couldn’t do this work without you. I also wanted to take some time to answer just a few of the many thoughtful questions members of this team have sent me. In case you missed it, my team and I kicked off our Ask Adam series to give folks like you the opportunity to submit any questions you might have about my work in the Senate ([ ]share your questions here!). So without further ado ... Nicole from California wrote “The Trump administration has clearly demonstrated that they will not act in good faith. What steps do Democrats plan to take outside of business as usual to deal with this power grab?” We can’t treat this as business as usual. We have to do several things, and do them well — oversight, legislation, litigation, communication, and mobilization. We need to do hard oversight, and not just when the TV cameras are rolling. We can do that by uncovering information and exposing it — which can force them to abandon plans. Part of this effort has included encouraging whistleblowers to come forward — and they have, greatly facilitating our ability to expose corruption and wrongdoing. We are also using every procedural tool at our disposal to block their power grabs and uncover what they’re doing. The slower they go, the less they can break. We need to legislate to try to stop the worst abuses and force Republicans to defend what they’re trying to do. Even though we’re in the minority, we can still introduce bills to block the worst abuses, put Republicans on record, and force them to defend their actions — like their push to cut Medicaid, defund Social Security, and raise taxes on working families while handing massive giveaways to billionaires. If they want to gut programs that millions rely on, they need to own that in broad daylight. We need to litigate in the courts to stop the many illegal and unconstitutional actions Trump and his cronies are undertaking. While Trump signs executive orders meant to create chaos and headlines, we’re working to file legal challenges that stop them from taking effect. There are already 20+ lawsuits challenging his most extreme moves — like his attempts to freeze federal funding and gut agencies from the inside. And we have had considerable success with this litigation. And we must better communicate, not only by sharpening our message but also by broadening the use of digital media and appearing on podcasts that expand our progressive reach. My YouTube channel is now the most highly watched of any member of Congress, and we are very active on all the other platforms as well, getting millions of views and mushrooming our engagement, perhaps the largest of any elected official. Finally, we can mobilize — that is where you come in. We can take to the streets and the national parks, we can show up at town halls and roundtables, we can make our voices heard and amplify our own opinions and the views of others. We must all engage to save our democracy. Carol from Florida wrote “Adam, I am a senior citizen and rely on my Social Security to get me through the month. Should I be worried that they are going to take that away from me?” Simply put, yes. Just last week, Elon Musk — who, let's remember, is Donald Trump’s top advisor and actor through DOGE — suggested he wanted to privatize Social Security and called it a “Ponzi scheme.” Then, this week, his hand-picked acting administrator began mass layoffs which will affect the ability of the agency to do its critical work. Listen, I’m going to fight like hell to keep this benefit for seniors which they have earned. Because it’s their money and because it has been an enormously successful program that helps people retire with dignity. What’s more, the only reason Trump and Musk want to make changes to Social Security is to find more money for their obscene tax cuts for millionaires and billionaires. And I’m confident that this is a fight that we will win — if the GOP is dumb enough to pick it. I will never stop fighting to protect your Social Security. You earned it. You paid into it. And I will do everything in my power to make sure it’s there for you, and for generations to come. Leslie from California wrote “I would like to know your recommendation of the most effective ways citizens can push back on the illegal activities of the current administration. I am concerned about our democracy, and want to participate in saving it.” Donald Trump and his administration want you to be afraid and to be cowed into silence and inaction. One of the most important things you can do is resist the urge to feel overwhelmed. That’s what they want. The chaos you see — the executive orders, the purges of career government employees, the attacks on federal agencies — is deliberate. It’s designed to make people feel paralyzed as if nothing we do matters. That is a lie. The truth is: we outnumber them. And when we take collective action, we can slow down, and even stop their most dangerous efforts. After that, here are some of the most important things you can do: (1) Call and write your Representatives – yes, this works! Don’t assume your member of Congress is voting the way you want them to; they need to hear from you. Demand they block Trump’s unqualified appointees and fight back against his budget cuts. (2) Support local efforts to protect democracy. Get involved with groups that are mobilizing at the local level to protect voting rights, support immigrant communities, and flip Republican seats. This can be as small as finding a local candidate to make calls for or contribute to. This work really matters. (3) Engage in elections at every level. Trump and his allies are watching to see if we mobilize. We have special elections coming up. They may seem small, but every race is a chance to build power and momentum for 2026. Get involved, volunteer, and help elect leaders who will fight back. The bottom line is that this administration wants us to believe that what they’re doing is inevitable. It’s not. Every person like you who’s donating time, energy, and resources helps hold the Trump administration accountable and slow down their attempts to break the system. It also builds real community and power, and that’s the work that moves us forward. [ ]Folks like you are going to play a significant role in helping us fight back against Trump’s assault on democracy and his plans to rip working families off. Don’t get bogged down by their attempts. We need you in the fight. Peter,

'decorum.’ It’s just like when a group of moderate, AIPAC-backed Democrats
(some of the same ones on this list) voted to censure Rep. Rashida Tlaib,
the only Palestinian-American in Congress, for speaking up against the
genocide and ethnic cleansing of Palestinians.

While the very fascism the Democratic Party warned us about during the
2024 election is here and wreaking havoc during Trump’s second term, the
establishment is still more concerned with following the rules than
fighting back.

body:
Republicans in Congress are trying to fast-track a bill that would block millions of American citizens from voting.
# [](https://act.jocelynbenson.com/go/203?t=1&akid=152%2E181023%2EAsF5pG)
Team, this headline from _CBS News_ should concern everybody:
[](https://act.jocelynbenson.com/signup/Stand-with-Jocelyn/?AU_JMB_EG_GEN_PET_AC_20250312_PM1_V1_S1&akid=152%2E181023%2EAsF5pG)
Right now, Republicans in Washington D.C. are trying to fast-track a bill that would block millions of American citizens from casting their ballots in future elections.
The _SAVE Act_ would drastically change the way elections are run by:
→ Requiring voters to register _in person_ with their birth certificate, U.S. passport, or naturalization certificate.
→ Eliminating a voter’s ability to register to vote online or by mail.
→ Forcing voters to go to an election clerk’s office every time they update their registration or change their address.
**Other states have already tried this policy. It doesn’t work.**
As Michigan’s Secretary of State, Jocelyn has worked tirelessly to protect every eligible Michigander’s right to vote. Under her leadership, Michigan has had record-breaking voter turnout in three consecutive elections.
But the _SAVE Act_ threatens all the progress we’ve made to ensure Michigan’s elections remain secure and accessible for Black Michiganders, active-duty troops, and the more than 2.2 million women in Michigan whose married names are not the same name on their birth certificates.
**The goal of the _SAVE Act_ isn’t to save democracy, but to end it. We can’t let this stand. **
**[Will you join Jocelyn’s fight to oppose the _SAVE Act_ and defend Michigan’s elections by adding your name to our petition today? ](https://act.jocelynbenson.com/signup/Stand-with-Jocelyn/?AU_JMB_EG_GEN_PET_AC_20250312_PM1_V1_S1&email=&akid=152%2E181023%2EAsF5pG)**

As Michigan’s next Governor, Jocelyn will stand up to anyone and everyone who tries to attack our most basic constitutional rights.
Thank you.
— Team Benson

Team,

Jason’s story is one of hard work, resilience, and standing up for what’s right — no matter how tough the fight may be.

Growing up, Jason worked minimum-wage jobs at McDonald’s and Arby’s to help make ends meet. To put himself through school, Jason worked construction and joined the National Guard.

After the horrific 9/11 attacks, Jason stepped up to serve his country. He served three combat tours in Iraq and Afghanistan — and in the process, learned the value of sacrifice, service, and putting others before himself.

When he came home from serving overseas, Jason could see that too many Coloradans were struggling. Housing prices were sky-high, and families were drowning under the rising costs of everyday essentials.

Jason saw another opportunity to serve his country, this time in Congress. He defeated a five-term GOP congressman and helped Democrats win back the House in 2018. Since then, he’s been committed to making sure the needs of hard working families are always top of mind.

We mobilized nationwide to get the PACT Act passed. Right now, we’re doing everything we can to save it. And if the GOP succeeds in killing it, we’re going to mobilize nationwide to make them pay.
#
Peter:
Republicans in the House voted to gut the PACT Act and rip billions of dollars in care from Veterans who are suffering from chronic diseases after toxic exposures during their time in service.
They voted last year to pass a budget with $22.8 billion for the Toxic Exposures Fund, starting on October 1st.
Last night, they passed a budget with ZERO dollars for the Toxic Exposures Fund, starting on October 1st.
They’re following Elon Musk and Trump, who are pushing the VA to fire 83,000 staff and set the agency back to 2019 — before the PACT Act was passed.
VoteVets was one of the primary organizations behind this bill. We worked at it for years, and Republicans obstructed it every step of the way. Many Republicans voted AGAINST this bill when it originally passed. But we got it done — and since then more than 2 MILLION claims from Veterans have been approved.
That’s 2 million Veterans getting the coverage and treatment they need after suffering for years — sometimes decades — without it.
That’s 2 million Veterans that Republicans in the House just voted to screw over — because Elon Musk and Donald Trump want them to.
We mobilized nationwide to get the PACT Act passed. Right now, we’re doing everything we can to save it. And if the GOP kills the PACT Act, we’re going to mobilize nationwide to make them pay.

| Peter,

Jeanne Shaheen - a true New Hampshire hero - announced her retirement from the Senate today. She made history as the first woman to serve as Governor of New Hampshire and the first woman in America to serve as both a Governor and a United States Senator. But she hasn't just held those jobs - she's done those jobs brilliantly.

Her superpower is her ability to listen - truly listen - to the people of New Hampshire, understand their needs, and deliver for them.

She digs in and does the hard work - including the work of building bipartisan coalitions to solve our toughest problems. And she's got an incredible record of results to show for it, from supporting workers and small businesses to making healthcare and childcare more affordable, to meeting our sacred obligation to our veterans, to standing up to dictators and despots.

In every corner of our state, I see her legacy living and breathing in the people and the communities she's helped over five decades of service to our state and our nation.

Like so many others, I'm deeply grateful I've had the chance to learn from her and to follow the example she's set for us all. And I look forward to working with her over the next two years in Congress to keep delivering for the people of New Hampshire.

-Maggie

body:
| | | | | | [](https://click.nodemleftbehind.com/click/gpnv-2wrdd7-vkun0o-kyd76rh4/)
---
# **MAGA Tariffs are Hurting the Working Class**
---
| [](https://click.nodemleftbehind.com/click/gpnv-2wrdd7-vkun0p-kyd76rh5/)
---
| | | | Dear friend, Donald Trump is at it again—playing reckless games with the economy and sticking hardworking Americans with the bill. His latest tariffs on aluminum and steel have set off a trade war that’s already punishing businesses, slashing jobs, and making everyday goods more expensive. Trump promised his tariffs would boost American jobs, but here’s the reality:
* **Major trade partners are hitting back** —Canada and the European Union are imposing stiff retaliatory tariffs on U.S. exports, including beef, bourbon, motorcycles, computers, and more. American companies are already bracing for billions in losses.
* **Prices are skyrocketing** —With higher tariffs, businesses will either take massive financial hits or pass those costs onto consumers. That means YOU will be paying more for everyday products—from food to tools to electronics.
* **Jobs are at risk** —Steel and aluminum might see short-term gains, but industries that rely on those materials—manufacturing, auto production, and small businesses—are already feeling the strain. European officials are deliberately targeting products made in states like Kansas, Nebraska, and Georgia—hurting Republican-held states that Trump claims to support.
* **History is repeating itself** —Trump pulled this same stunt during his first term, and the results were disastrous. Now, he’s doubling down on a failed policy that nearly tanked key American industries.

Even the American Chamber of Commerce is sounding the alarm, warning that these tariffs will "only harm jobs, prosperity, and security on both sides of the Atlantic." The reality is simple: **Trump’s economic policies don’t work.** They never have. They never will. Greetings from Gay Valimont, FL-1 Candidate.
Recent developments in Washington have brought us to the brink of a shutdown. The House narrowly passed a bill to fund federal agencies through September, reducing non-defense spending by $13 billion while increasing defense spending by $6 billion. This bill now moves to the Senate, where its fate remains uncertain. With only 20 days until special elections, Dems are pushing to fight against MAGA and are struggling. I need your help to get our federal agencies back.
[https://d15k2d11r6t6rl.cloudfront.net/public/users/Integrators/04eaa6b2-88f4-43b4-b978-7bb0708f5838/3357446746555462574C76537A562F5831617438666F526F79722F34676D6E64316768793955503947614B337A67665535506F6E2B78696F707A44307A6B2B50/editor_images/Screenshot%202025-03-12%20at%2012.10.12%E2%80%AFPM.png]
A government shutdown would have severe consequences for Florida's residents:
- Economic Impact: Federal employees in our state could face furloughs, leading to financial instability for thousands of families. Local businesses that rely on government contracts may experience delays or cancellations, affecting their operations and employees.
- Public Services: Essential services that many Floridians depend on could be disrupted, from processing Social Security claims to administering veterans' benefits.
- Education: The Department of Education has already announced plans to cut nearly half its workforce as part of the administration's agenda to dismantle the agency. This move threatens federal funding for our schools, support for students with disabilities, and resources for underprivileged districts.
These developments underscore a troubling trend toward undermining the institutions that serve and protect our citizens.
As your advocate, I am committed to fighting against such reckless actions. We must demand that our leaders prioritize the well-being of Floridians over partisan agendas. It's imperative to support policies that ensure stable funding for essential services, protect our educational institutions, and uphold the integrity of our public sector.
Help me secure our government and restore our federal institutions to keep America safe and functioning. Without you, I can’t secure this last leg of the race. Click to donate $5, $10, or whatever makes sense for you to make this happen! [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/gay2025klemail]

# [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/103745162/533106469/-1397648958?refcode=AU_AZD_FR_TAN_GEN_AC90_20250312_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjUvMS8xMDU1MTYiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMThiODA1NzItN2ZmZi1lZjExLTkwY2QtMDAyMjQ4MmE5ZmI3IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=fMBaz6SPTsYsAsRjJWJLUSphQRlelKGInPOvNwMkb-Q=)

I have some exciting news: I’m launching my campaign for Governor of the great state of New Mexico — my home — to bring our state together and build a bright future for all who live here. I’m humbly asking: [**Will you join us by donating just $3 or more to my campaign and the Arizona Democratic Party now? **](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/103745163/533106470/541112194?amount=3&refcode=AU_AZD_FR_TAN_GEN_AC90_20250312_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjUvMS8xMDU1MTYiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMThiODA1NzItN2ZmZi1lZjExLTkwY2QtMDAyMjQ4MmE5ZmI3IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=fMBaz6SPTsYsAsRjJWJLUSphQRlelKGInPOvNwMkb-Q=) The amount you give doesn’t matter. What matters is building a campaign with the support of real people. That’s who I am and who I came from. That’s who I am running to serve. My roots in New Mexico run 35 generations deep. The Pueblo people were the first farmers in the high deserts of New Mexico, an agricultural tradition that still continues today. I am here because of my grandfather, who worked for decades as a diesel mechanic on the railroad. Somehow he also kept a field — picking worms off the corn as it grew, like the generations before him. I am here because of my grandmother, a survivor and a caretaker who woke up every day before the sun. She was the one who gave me my true love of cooking New Mexican cuisine. (She wouldn’t let us in the kitchen while she cooked, but I’d perch myself outside and watch her through the window for hours.) I am here because of my parents and their sacrifice. My mother, a Pueblo woman, served in the Navy. My father, a Marine, received a Silver Star for his service in Vietnam. He now lies in honor at Arlington. I am here because of my beloved child, who I raised on my own. I started a small business to pay the bills, but it still wasn’t always enough. We relied on food stamps to get on our feet. I sometimes had to decide between paying rent and buying groceries to feed our family. I will never forget how that felt or the kindness of those who helped us – strangers who became community. When I look at my Somah, I see perseverance, strength and hope. These are my stories. These are stories of New Mexico. These days, our differences are blown so far out of proportion. We lose sight of a simple fact: we all live in the same state, together. All of us in New Mexico come from love, survival, and sacrifice. We all want to live good lives — and we want even more for our children. The current president and his billionaire friends look at the lands and the people of this country and think: what can I exploit? I am running to ask: if we come together in New Mexico, what good can we do for each other and for the next generation? We have our work cut out for us. The cost of living is crushing our families. Our economy is growing, but we need to make sure everyone shares in our progress. Our families need more. Our farmers and ranchers need more. New Mexico’s children need so much more. And we must be good stewards of the Earth, and preserve the rivers, mesas, farmlands, and forests whose beauty sustains our communities. I am running to do all this and more. I am running to serve all New Mexicans and make sure we’re leaving a better future for our children. [**Will you join us with a donation, split between my campaign and the Arizona Democratic Party?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/103745164/533106471/541112194?refcode=AU_AZD_FR_TAN_GEN_AC90_20250312_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjUvMS8xMDU1MTYiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMThiODA1NzItN2ZmZi1lZjExLTkwY2QtMDAyMjQ4MmE5ZmI3IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=fMBaz6SPTsYsAsRjJWJLUSphQRlelKGInPOvNwMkb-Q=) I would be honored to have your support. Many thanks to Arizona Democrats for helping spread the word. I hope you’ll join us! Be fierce, Deb

Last night, our endorsed climate champion David Gottfried defeated an attempted Republican power grab in Minnesota — delivering a must-win special election that broke the GOP majority in the state House. That means Trump’s allies won’t be able to steamroll their pro-polluter agenda through the state. This is what it looks like to build a firewall of pro-climate power to stop Big Oil. This is how we resist. And this is our third special election victory so far this year. ✅ First , we helped Kannan Srinivasan win in Virginia, keeping the state Senate in Democratic hands and stopping Republican efforts to gut clean energy laws. ✅ Then , we helped Doron Clark win a critical seat in Minnesota, restoring the state Senate’s pro-climate majority. ✅ Now , we’ve won again in the state House — protecting Minnesota’s climate progress and the state from Republicans’ efforts to roll back progress on climate, reproductive rights and so much more. Three wins in three months. The grassroots momentum is real. And if we keep this up? We can stop Trump’s allies in their tracks. = Over 100,000 down-ballot seats around the country are on the line this year. Some of the most critical state legislatures are controlled by a single vote, meaning a race as small as last night’s can literally decide the balance of power. Trump is working around the clock to stack his administration with MAGA loyalists, Big Oil cronies, and right-wing extremists to do everything in his power to undo every ounce of climate progress. The loss of trust in the mainstream media is well-founded and well-deserved. For far too long, the media has positioned itself as the gatekeeper of information. They decide what stories the people need to know and what stories shouldn’t be seen.

Look no further than two stories from last week, and see if you can spot the difference. Both involve singers, and both involve politics, but they were covered very differently.

Last week, I was invited to join HUD Secretary Scott Turner to survey the damage from January’s California wildfires and to take part in the conversation about rebuilding Los Angeles.

Why did I get the invitation? Because when the wildfires were raging, Let Us Worship put out the call, and believers from across the country flooded into Los Angeles with supplies and donations. subject: The Good, The Bad, and The Ugly
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Ruth's List Florida Incorporated
body:
RuthsListFL.org [RuthsListFL.org]
Peter,
Florida’s 2025 Legislative Session is in full swing, and we want to share with you the bills that we are currently tracking in our State House and Senate. Check out below the good, bad, and ugly bills of this Session, and find out how you can take action!
The Good: SB 870 [https://www.flsenate.gov/Session/Bill/2025/870] / HB 1139 [https://flhouse.gov/Sections/Bills/billsdetail.aspx?BillId=81816] ( This bill needs your support!)
This bill would repeal the ban on abortions after 6-weeks of gestation, instead allowing abortions until the fetus reaches viability. The passage of this bill would widen the window for patients to receive an abortion, and has the potential to save countless lives. This bill is sponsored by House Democratic Leader Fentrice Driskell and Senate Democratic Leader Pro-Tempore Tracie Davis, with several of our pro-choice Democratic women joining them as co-sponsors.
TAKE ACTION: Now that the bill has been referred to committees in both the House and Senate, it’s time to put the pressure on Committee Chairs to put this bill on their agendas:
- Senator Colleen Burton (Chair, Health Policy) [https://www.flsenate.gov/Senators/S12] : Call or email Senator Burton’s office and demand that SB 870 is added to the next meeting agenda.
- Representative Kaylee Tuck (Chair, Health Professions & Programs): [https://flhouse.gov/Sections/Representatives/contactmember.aspx?MemberId=4776&SessionId=105] Call or email Representative Tuck’s office and demand that HB 1139 is added to the next meeting agenda.
The Bad: “Fetal Personhood” and Banning Birth Control
SB 1284: Civil Liability for the Wrongful Death of an Unborn Child [https://www.flsenate.gov/Session/Bill/2025/1284] would open the doors for civil lawsuits against health care providers for providing reproductive care. This overly broad bill is a solution looking for a problem, and a veiled attempt to establish “fetal personhood” and effectively ban all abortions in our state. As law, it would jeopardize access to fertility treatments like IVF and even chemotherapy. Interpretations of such laws can even go so far as to incite criminal charges against a woman for having a miscarriage.
SB 1288: Parental Rights [https://www.flsenate.gov/Session/Bill/2025/1288] aims to prevent minors from safely accessing sexual and reproductive healthcare. By repealing existing statutes which allow minors to receive certain care without parental consent (like birth control and STI testing), this legislation would prohibit providers from giving such care to young patients who cannot procure parental consent. Like parental consent laws on abortion care, this bill would harm many young people who are trying to prevent pregnancy and illness, especially those that may already live in precarious situations.
The Ugly: Boldfaced Attacks on the Democratic Process
There are currently three bills filed that target the citizen-lead ballot initiative process: SB 1414 [https://www.flsenate.gov/Session/Bill/2025/1414] , HB 1205 [https://www.flhouse.gov/Sections/Bills/billsdetail.aspx?BillId=81899&SessionId=105] , and HB 1381 [https://www.flhouse.gov/Sections/Bills/billsdetail.aspx?BillId=82105&SessionId=105] . These bills are part of a multi-pronged attack, ranging from increasing the Governor’s power to strike amendments from the ballot to mandating a $1,000,000 bond to begin the process. These bills thoroughly cover the petition gathering process in red tape, making it nearly impossible for real people to directly pass policies, such as constitutional protections for abortion rights. After 2024’s Amendment 4 narrowly failed to pass with 57% of the vote, Ron DeSantis and Republicans in the Legislature are making sure that no real citizen-led effort even comes close to passing in Florida ever again.
TAKE ACTION: Protect Citizen-Led Amendments: Coalition Sign Up! [https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdgzifS6WoHV6hXm_BdWuizF9F0yZJAEfNcABZbAC16aCN1lA/viewform]
If you’ve made it this far, you are probably deeply invested in Florida’s future. We’re glad that you’re staying informed with us, and we plan to keep you in the loop throughout this legislative session so that together we can take action.
If you want to receive more information and newsletters like this, sign-up today to become an official Ruth's List Florida Member. [https://secure.everyaction.com/8cwTh9SKtki9m3dtA63xeQ2] This year, we're offering a new member sign-up special: donate $25/month to receive full member benefits!
BECOME A MEMBER [https://secure.everyaction.com/8cwTh9SKtki9m3dtA63xeQ2]
Thank you for staying with us in this fight.
In Solidarity,

This overly broad bill is a solution looking for a problem, and a veiled attempt to establish “fetal personhood” and effectively ban all abortions in our state. As law, it would jeopardize access to fertility treatments like IVF and even chemotherapy. Interpretations of such laws can even go so far as to incite criminal charges against a woman for having a miscarriage. SB 1288: Parental Rights [] aims to prevent minors from safely accessing sexual and reproductive healthcare. By repealing existing statutes which allow minors to receive certain care without parental consent (like birth control and STI testing), this legislation would prohibit providers from giving such care to young patients who cannot procure parental consent. Like parental consent laws on abortion care, this bill would harm many young people who are trying to prevent pregnancy and illness, especially those that may already live in precarious situations. The Ugly: Boldfaced Attacks on the Democratic Process There are currently three bills filed that target the citizen-lead ballot initiative process: SB 1414 [] , HB 1205 [] , and HB 1381 [] . These bills are part of a multi-pronged attack, ranging from increasing the Governor’s power to strike amendments from the ballot to mandating a $1,000,000 bond to begin the process. These bills thoroughly cover the petition gathering process in red tape, making it nearly impossible for real people to directly pass policies, such as constitutional protections for abortion rights. After 2024’s Amendment 4 narrowly failed to pass with 57% of the vote, Ron DeSantis and Republicans in the Legislature are making sure that no real citizen-led effort even comes close to passing in Florida ever again. | | Peter,

For too long, toxic wastewater pollution in the Tijuana River Valley has been threatening the health of San Diegans, our coastal waters, and local businesses. But thanks to Scott’s leadership, we finally have the resources to fix this crisis.

Scott and the San Diego Congressional delegation have **secured $650 million to fully repair and expand the South Bay International Wastewater Treatment Plant** (SBIWTP) – a crucial step toward stopping cross-border sewage pollution.

But this fight isn’t over – **House Republicans’ proposed budget slashes funding for the organization that operates the SBIWTP in _half_.**

This would jeopardize the treatment plant’s annual funding for operations, maintenance, and future construction projects. Scott is leading the charge to protect this funding, **unlock additional funding sources** , and strengthen partnerships that will protect our water for generations to come.

[Stand with Scott to ensure this project is fully funded and completed. subject: Hell yeah I'm going to talk to you about my qualifications!

body:
#
The other night I went on Instagram Live to talk about Elon Musk appointing teenagers to raid the Department of the Treasury. Someone commented “a bartender Congresswoman talking about qualifications.”
I know what it's like to be a working-class person.
And I got elected as the youngest woman in American history to Congress with my knowledge, and my ability to organize and connect with my community.
So when any one of these people can win an election with that kind of a background and they don't take lobbyist money, **then they can give me a call.**
Until then these people seem to be having three martini lunches, thinking that they can command the respect of the Defense Department. **Give me a break.**
Our fight for transformative change makes a lot of classist, ageist, misogynist, and racist people mad.
But together, we’ve built a movement that won’t back down. Thank you for being a part of it.

name: Kimberly Bretches
subject: Life behind bars could be his “reward.”
body:
Up against a George Soros backed prosecutor| | | The same city that gave Chance this award is trying to put him in prison for life for doing his job.
---
| |
---
Dear Patriot, That's me and my husband, Officer Chance Bretches in the picture I've sent you...
---
[](http://links.conservativesfordjt.com/u/click?_t=05b03ef2209247bcbdad7fd5099cd670&_m=8a15cda4af2f4ebf8bbbf9b367828646&_e=2H53P7Wcfsh1nCbFaDGKurN0R7VWbbqCIYxqS19OyP9K0q12q_yGfwzRTEDUkZ-oa2QQdtFDorwzNPZwEZkuru_6T2q7q5pIV6qc5q9fGBRJ-NyFYtKV1D9eQXNJRqHQFdeKOFzkjDUTxXPUMDqs0_FC3lL1jsSSXj_55Z-4M78O-FsCUYJ4QLS9tt90WE69-1Vby-iyjQGhR9DTvLoPAaIgG1xN7fvvVk71qfZI1geKmBPmMT2oH7-gFrCex2Iz9_LRxfj2sjjv87k3gmMjcJiAP3avNcHY_IFEzQErb8dfCX_t2LauP4ztDYFjacttHYIJzpy4Ees7GfipdgBTtU5JGpSjYv2v_SoEht15xK48W_aqBXXl3yqnSgv5Z91U)
---
...a picture we took on the day Chance received the Lifesaving Medal With Valor for rescuing a driver from a crashed car that had caught on fire. This photo used to be one of my favorites. Now looking at it makes me cry. Because in July, the same city that gave Chance this award... ...will try to lock him up for life for doing his job. I should explain. For nearly 13 years, Chance has been a decorated police officer with the Austin, Texas Police Department. But in May of 2020, our lives were turned upside down. You probably remember what it was like in our country after George Floyd. Violent, fiery anti-police protests were sweeping through cities. Every step of the way, they were cheered on by radical politicians, Soros-funded prosecutors, and the Mainstream Media who lied to us and said, with a straight face, that these riots were "mostly peaceful." It was especially bad here in Austin, Texas. For three nights in a row, angry, anti-cop mobs rampaged through downtown, smashing windows, burning police cars, and looting stores. The crowd attacked officers like my husband who were trying to keep the peace, pelting them with rocks, bricks, and even lit fireworks. On the third night, things got even worse. Protestors shut down interstate, and a crazed mob surrounded Police Headquarters. Chance and his fellow officers knew that if they didn't restore order quickly, the headquarters, and maybe even the entire city, might burn to the ground. Following their training, they fired non-lethal weapons – the same "beanbag guns" that police have used for years to break up riots – to stop the violence before it got out of hand. The mob slunk off. And my husband made it home safe and sound. What I didn’t know then was that this nightmare wasn't over for us. Far from it. Unknown to Chance and the other officers on duty that night, an anti-police protestor was hit by one of my husband's non-lethal rounds. They claimed they were injured and lost part of their finger. And for that... ...the county prosecutor charged my husband with "aggravated assault by a public servant" -- a charge punishable by life in prison. This is the upside-down world we live in now. A world where lawless thugs who fling rocks at police and try to burn our city to the ground get off scot-free... ...while law-abiding officers get criminal charges and face life in prison for following their training and breaking up a mob of rioters. What are cops like my husband supposed to do when faced with this kind of out-of-control violence?! When Chance told me about the charges, my emotions went from disbelief to anger to despair...and back again. But it all started to make sense when we learned that the prosecutor in this case owes his election to a wad of campaign cash from none other than radical Leftist billionaire George Soros. That was when I realized that the anti-cop crowd is trying to get revenge on my husband. They don't care if my husband is innocent. They'll do everything in their power to make cops pay. It makes me wonder why anyone would ever sign up to join law enforcement these days. But nearly 13 years ago, my husband did. And he did it because helping innocent people is in his blood. His brother is a firefighter. His dad is a 34-year police veteran. My husband is a youth leader at our church and plays guitar in the worship band. He's served on mission trips -- planting churches, planning vacation Bible schools, and sharing the Gospel. And he's done his job as a police officer with honor and dignity, without a single mark against his record. Chance put his life on the line to protect our city from a violent, unhinged mob... ...and life behind bars and could be his "reward." Even if my husband's good name is cleared there is no way we could hope to pay the mountain of legal bills. Thankfully, by God's grace, there is one group who has stepped up to help us -- the Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund (LELDF). If you've ever heard of LELDF, you know that their record has made them a policemen's best friend. Jason Johnson and the LELDF board organize and fund the successful legal defense of good cops wrongly charged for crimes -- like my husband. LELDF hires the best attorneys and secures expert witnesses who will testify to the truth -- without being influenced by political paybacks. And now they've agreed to help Chance. My friend, you've read my letter this far so I'm going to ask as boldly as I can: Will you help Chance, too? _**[Would you help by sending a one-time gift to LELDF so this amazing group can defend my husband and the other good police officers who have wrongly accused?](http://links.conservativesfordjt.com/u/click?_t=05b03ef2209247bcbdad7fd5099cd670&_m=8a15cda4af2f4ebf8bbbf9b367828646&_e=2H53P7Wcfsh1nCbFaDGKurN0R7VWbbqCIYxqS19OyP9K0q12q_yGfwzRTEDUkZ-oa2QQdtFDorwzNPZwEZkuru_6T2q7q5pIV6qc5q9fGBRJ-NyFYtKV1D9eQXNJRqHQFdeKOFzkjDUTxXPUMDqs0_FC3lL1jsSSXj_55Z-4M78O-FsCUYJ4QLS9tt90WE69-1Vby-iyjQGhR9DTvLoPAaIgG1xN7fvvVk71qfZI1gekl_ao2AmmMpZV7qVp3n0tf934ydjgO0nPmZ1YUOmTwDRjYYNRcPtG8zrNF97DllpoyeVR5zu2zjnysnFY1IRe7m2WsYh-ZgFd_WvMoq-fC_QDQ7reTMD_PVZtMZP0bH8WB5N5HqAO3wa-hzyiVYfx)**_** ** You see, LELDF is a non-profit organization. They rely entirely on the generosity of kind-hearted folks like you to defend the men and women in blue who defend us. _**[So with that in mind, please know that any contribution -- be it $35, $100, $500 or even $1,000 -- is tax-deductible.](http://links.conservativesfordjt.com/u/click?_t=05b03ef2209247bcbdad7fd5099cd670&_m=8a15cda4af2f4ebf8bbbf9b367828646&_e=2H53P7Wcfsh1nCbFaDGKurN0R7VWbbqCIYxqS19OyP9K0q12q_yGfwzRTEDUkZ-oa2QQdtFDorwzNPZwEZkuru_6T2q7q5pIV6qc5q9fGBRJ-NyFYtKV1D9eQXNJRqHQFdeKOFzkjDUTxXPUMDqs0_FC3lL1jsSSXj_55Z-4M78O-FsCUYJ4QLS9tt90WE69-1Vby-iyjQGhR9DTvLoPAaIgG1xN7fvvVk71qfZI1gdZ5nAmAU3m8Xy4uW_c5kc7ry5nFUEuVuzzEBjyQnhl80-qx_FPfcICFXZjh4SB0SFDckmljMBSnOY7HwcHcTuzd9blJ7_a6SzjPfJO4qyC_fMOAhM51pGLndGgOxYh7eAormbdEIkwWPmgA0YhNxai)**_ But whatever you feel led to give, please end it back quickly. Chance's trial starts on July 7th. Our legal team needs to be working day and night getting ready for his defense. Because if Chance is found guilty... ...he'll spend every wedding anniversary, birthday, and Christmas for the rest of his life in prison. He won't be able to take our sons to football games or teach them how to drive... He won't be able to walk our daughter down the aisle somebody... I can't bear the thought of life without him. And I know what happens to former police officers when they get locked up with thousands of criminals. My only hope of saving him today is good-hearted patriots like you. _**[So please, my friend, rush back your gift right away if possible.](http://links.conservativesfordjt.com/u/click?_t=05b03ef2209247bcbdad7fd5099cd670&_m=8a15cda4af2f4ebf8bbbf9b367828646&_e=2H53P7Wcfsh1nCbFaDGKurN0R7VWbbqCIYxqS19OyP9K0q12q_yGfwzRTEDUkZ-oa2QQdtFDorwzNPZwEZkuru_6T2q7q5pIV6qc5q9fGBRJ-NyFYtKV1D9eQXNJRqHQFdeKOFzkjDUTxXPUMDqs0_FC3lL1jsSSXj_55Z-4M78O-FsCUYJ4QLS9tt90WE69-1Vby-iyjQGhR9DTvLoPAaIgG1xN7fvvVk71qfZI1gd4zn9890gXHv3bD7Gg1w9qsZfXer4eljAq_ITbhaamcOq5fR-Avfin33PFJValke2-tP4XkbsQpV0lPejSE4dbqmX8RAh7BLbXTxVwrKFTOLgfWXQ7FKUXwOCuTb2e6x7I5peYmvVYmB4qlIPj28FJ)**_ With this radical Soros-funded prosecutor on the warpath, _**[your gift of $35](http://links.conservativesfordjt.com/u/click?_t=05b03ef2209247bcbdad7fd5099cd670&_m=8a15cda4af2f4ebf8bbbf9b367828646&_e=2H53P7Wcfsh1nCbFaDGKurN0R7VWbbqCIYxqS19OyP9K0q12q_yGfwzRTEDUkZ-oa2QQdtFDorwzNPZwEZkuru_6T2q7q5pIV6qc5q9fGBRJ-NyFYtKV1D9eQXNJRqHQFdeKOFzkjDUTxXPUMDqs0_FC3lL1jsSSXj_55Z-4M78O-FsCUYJ4QLS9tt90WE69-1Vby-iyjQGhR9DTvLoPAaIgG1xN7fvvVk71qfZI1gfwk46D_Xa3H9fydcE4KtjhQtKHNxC-Fx6Nnvbipx7pT5O5s4XvdG9pGnVkHCPnT13CfPOUu44sFkOnGH3sOVPPEUZQbDEGzw3sZ_VSdrhrlkZtBxxiWzAOuR4uMFUdBr3P8GZg7wgvhHdpuCjr8KIs)**_ \-- or any amount -- could be the difference between Chance clearing his good name... ...and spending the rest of his life behind bars. Thank you for reading my email today with such a generous spirit. I can never express how grateful I am to you -- in advance -- for helping my husband fight back.
---
With hope and thanks,
---
Kimberly Bretches
---
P.S. My husband Chance put his life on the line to keep our city safe from a rabid mob of violent protestors. Now life behind bars could be his "reward."And to make things worse, we're up against the deep pockets of a George Soros backed prosecutor in court. We have very little time to act before Chance's trial begins. Chance and I have three children -- and one more on the way. Please don't let them grow up without their father. _**[Thank you for any help you can send to LELDF today.](http://links.conservativesfordjt.com/u/click?_t=05b03ef2209247bcbdad7fd5099cd670&_m=8a15cda4af2f4ebf8bbbf9b367828646&_e=2H53P7Wcfsh1nCbFaDGKurN0R7VWbbqCIYxqS19OyP9K0q12q_yGfwzRTEDUkZ-oa2QQdtFDorwzNPZwEZkuru_6T2q7q5pIV6qc5q9fGBRJ-NyFYtKV1D9eQXNJRqHQFdeKOFzkjDUTxXPUMDqs0_FC3lL1jsSSXj_55Z-4M78O-FsCUYJ4QLS9tt90WE69-1Vby-iyjQGhR9DTvLoPAaIgG1xN7fvvVk71qfZI1gePPattXU30T92trxPM-v6OphDr00n-6ikJ9merhpIREKpMEfwrw7jBNV5K05FNW2ZR9xUzzVH8xhdVG4ZwwxoxOzP-e6VLXnOtbxdaV6-Jl5yW4j-ZYjhIbPB8wrohrFbvJfJFVAivXj0FoB0fhNF1)**_

Every step of the way, they were cheered on by radical politicians, Soros-funded prosecutors, and the Mainstream Media who lied to us and said, with a straight face, that these riots were "mostly peaceful." It was especially bad here in Austin, Texas. For three nights in a row, angry, anti-cop mobs rampaged through downtown, smashing windows, burning police cars, and looting stores. The crowd attacked officers like my husband who were trying to keep the peace, pelting them with rocks, bricks, and even lit fireworks. On the third night, things got even worse. Protestors shut down interstate, and a crazed mob surrounded Police Headquarters. Chance and his fellow officers knew that if they didn't restore order quickly, the headquarters, and maybe even the entire city, might burn to the ground. Following their training, they fired non-lethal weapons – the same "beanbag guns" that police have used for years to break up riots – to stop the violence before it got out of hand. The mob slunk off. And my husband made it home safe and sound. What I didn’t know then was that this nightmare wasn't over for us. Far from it. Unknown to Chance and the other officers on duty that night, an anti-police protestor was hit by one of my husband's non-lethal rounds. They claimed they were injured and lost part of their finger. And for that... ...the county prosecutor charged my husband with "aggravated assault by a public servant" -- a charge punishable by life in prison. This is the upside-down world we live in now. A world where lawless thugs who fling rocks at police and try to burn our city to the ground get off scot-free... ...while law-abiding officers get criminal charges and face life in prison for following their training and breaking up a mob of rioters. What are cops like my husband supposed to do when faced with this kind of out-of-control violence?! When Chance told me about the charges, my emotions went from disbelief to anger to despair...and back again. But it all started to make sense when we learned that the prosecutor in this case owes his election to a wad of campaign cash from none other than radical Leftist billionaire George Soros. That was when I realized that the anti-cop crowd is trying to get revenge on my husband. They don't care if my husband is innocent. They'll do everything in their power to make cops pay. It makes me wonder why anyone would ever sign up to join law enforcement these days. But nearly 13 years ago, my husband did. And he did it because helping innocent people is in his blood. His brother is a firefighter. His dad is a 34-year police veteran. My husband is a youth leader at our church and plays guitar in the worship band. He's served on mission trips -- planting churches, planning vacation Bible schools, and sharing the Gospel. And he's done his job as a police officer with honor and dignity, without a single mark against his record. Chance put his life on the line to protect our city from a violent, unhinged mob... ...and life behind bars and could be his "reward." Even if my husband's good name is cleared there is no way we could hope to pay the mountain of legal bills. Thankfully, by God's grace, there is one group who has stepped up to help us -- the Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund (LELDF). If you've ever heard of LELDF, you know that their record has made them a policemen's best friend. Jason Johnson and the LELDF board organize and fund the successful legal defense of good cops wrongly charged for crimes -- like my husband. LELDF hires the best attorneys and secures expert witnesses who will testify to the truth -- without being influenced by political paybacks. And now they've agreed to help Chance. My friend, you've read my letter this far so I'm going to ask as boldly as I can: Will you help Chance, too? You see, LELDF is a non-profit organization. They rely entirely on the generosity of kind-hearted folks like you to defend the men and women in blue who defend us. But whatever you feel led to give, please end it back quickly. Chance's trial starts on July 7th. Our legal team needs to be working day and night getting ready for his defense. Because if Chance is found guilty... ...he'll spend every wedding anniversary, birthday, and Christmas for the rest of his life in prison. He won't be able to take our sons to football games or teach them how to drive... He won't be able to walk our daughter down the aisle somebody... I can't bear the thought of life without him. And I know what happens to former police officers when they get locked up with thousands of criminals. My only hope of saving him today is good-hearted patriots like you. With this radical Soros-funded prosecutor on the warpath, \-- or any amount -- could be the difference between Chance clearing his good name... ...and spending the rest of his life behind bars. Thank you for reading my email today with such a generous spirit. I can never express how grateful I am to you -- in advance -- for helping my husband fight back. With hope and thanks, Kimberly Bretches P.S. My husband Chance put his life on the line to keep our city safe from a rabid mob of violent protestors. Now life behind bars could be his "reward."And to make things worse, we're up against the deep pockets of a George Soros backed prosecutor in court. We have very little time to act before Chance's trial begins. Chance and I have three children -- and one more on the way. Please don't let them grow up without their father. | More such officers who sacrifice so much for will face similar fates unless we speak out and stand up for the brave men and women in blue. The next time you see a police officer in your community, please thank them for their service. To read more about our mission or the other Law Enforcement officers we're defending, please visit. And remember –Blue Lives Matter! © Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund | 2560 Huntington Ave. Suite 203, Alexandria, VA, 22303
