**Missouri's Medicaid unwinding kicked nearly 200,000 children off insurance, more than most states** Peter,

More than 200,000 children in Missouri have been kicked off Medicaid – _not because they no longer needed affordable care,_ **but because Republican leadership simply does not care about them.**

We wish we were exaggerating. We wish this were some kind of mistake. But it's not. Republicans have spent _years_ making it harder for Missouri families to access the healthcare they deserve – and now, kids across our state are paying the price.

These are children with asthma who can’t get their inhalers. Kids with disabilities losing access to therapies that help them walk and talk. Families that are already struggling, now forced to make impossible choices between rent, food, and medical bills.

_And the worst part?_ **The people who did this don’t care.**

**They see these kids as numbers on a balance sheet, not as real people with real struggles.**

That’s not who Wesley is. That’s not who we are.

body:
The folks at POLITICO asked me why I think Congress and our politics are so broken.
#
Derek, it's John Fetterman.
The folks at POLITICO asked me why I think Congress and our politics are so broken, and that was one of the easiest questions I think I’ve *ever* answered:
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20250312?refcode=em20250312-9983&refcode2=9983_434096_X8cu_f&akid=9983%2E434096%2EX8cu_f)
**Money in politics is a cancer, and _Citizens United_ — the Supreme Court decision that allowed it — needs to go. 🙅♂️**

name: Tamie Wilson
subject: Jim Jordan hides as Ohio vets fight for their lives
body:
alt [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP33/1/100067/images/LOGO.jpg]
Friends,
This week, veterans and their supporters stood outside the VA clinic in Parma, Ohio, pleading for their jobs, their healthcare, and their dignity.
They’re rallying against the devastating 80,000 job cuts at the VA—cuts that will leave thousands of Ohio veterans stranded without the care they need.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-c2g-post-elec?refcode=20250312_va_cuts_image [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-c2g-post-elec?refcode=20250312_va_cuts_image]
These workers aren’t just numbers on a budget spreadsheet.
They’re the nurses who stay late to care for a veteran recovering from surgery. They’re the administrators who fight through red tape to get benefits processed faster.
They’re the doctors treating PTSD, the social workers helping homeless veterans find stable housing, the caregivers who have dedicated their lives to serving those who served.
And yet, the Trump administration is gutting the VA, stripping away essential services and putting 20,000 Ohio jobs on the line—including thousands in Jim Jordan’s own district.
And where is Jim Jordan?
Too busy chasing after a Fox News camera to spout his latest “woke mind virus” conspiracy theory or finding a new way to stay weirdly obsessed with Hunter Biden instead of standing with Ohio veterans.
He’s not fighting to save their jobs. Not offering a single solution.
Instead, Jim Jordan is enthusiastically supporting these devastating cuts.
If you believe our veterans deserve more than betrayal and budget cuts, chip in now to help us replace Jim Jordan with a leader who will actually fight for them. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-c2g-post-elec?refcode=20250312_va_cuts_link1]
Rather than lifting a finger to protect the thousands of VA workers in his district, he’s dismissing them as “leftists” and pushing conspiracy theories—because in Jordan’s world, anyone who dares ask for basic dignity and fairness must be part of some deep-state plot.
I’ve always stood with our veterans—because they stood for us.
I’ve worked with veteran advocacy groups to push for expanded healthcare access, fought against GOP-led attempts to privatize the VA, and spoken out against the outrageous backlog of disability claims that leave too many veterans without the care they need.
I’ve supported expanding mental health services, ensuring veterans struggling with PTSD and service-related injuries get the treatment they deserve.
And guess what? I will always fight to protect and strengthen the benefits our veterans have earned – because that’s the social contract we have in a free and fair democracy.
If you put your life on the line for this country, the very least we can do is ensure you have the care, support, and dignity you deserve.
I wish I could say I was surprised, but Jim Jordan has spent 18 years in Congress betraying our veterans:
* He voted against the PACT Act, which expanded healthcare for veterans exposed to toxic burn pits.

* He opposed increased funding for mental health services for veterans struggling with PTSD.

* He voted against expanding housing assistance for homeless veterans.

* He blocked funding to address the massive VA claims backlog that leaves veterans waiting months for care.
All of these examples and more are why we’re in this race.
Because Ohio veterans deserve more than cheap flag-waving and empty slogans. They deserve leadership. They deserve action.
And they damn well deserve a Congressperson who will fight for them—not sell them out.
We are building a movement to defeat Jim Jordan and put Ohioans first. Chip in today to fuel this fight. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-c2g-post-elec?refcode=20250312_va_cuts_link2]
Working for US,
Tamie Wilson

GOP congressman and Army veteran John James **[called out CNN's Wolf Blitzer ](https://substack.com/redirect/d71f2791-fd08-4bdd-ae3f-fc77666d4975?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**during a live interview for criticizing Trump's pardon of January 6 rioters who attacked police after calling BLM rioters who attacked police "peaceful protesters."
[Watch Video](https://substack.com/redirect/d71f2791-fd08-4bdd-ae3f-fc77666d4975?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
[](https://substack.com/redirect/d71f2791-fd08-4bdd-ae3f-fc77666d4975?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
"Was President Trump right in commuting the sentences of these rioters who wound up with bats and sticks and beat police officers?!" Blitzer asked James.
The congressman immediately fired back, "You know, leftists weren't too concerned with attacks on law enforcement when we saw them getting cold cocked on the New York City streets during BLM riots a couple years ago,... If you're going to be upset with one, you have to be upset with the other, or we call that hypocrisy."
"Were the BLM rioters right when they went across the country and burned..." James continued before being interrupted.
"I'm not asking about BLM, I'm asking you about January 6!" Blitzer said, frustrated with James' response.
"You see this is part of your problem!" James responded. "The reason people feel disconnected from pundits and politicians is because you don't understand where people are coming from. People see chaos all over the country and they see one side get punished while the other doesn't!"
Watch Blitzer get called out as a hypocrite during the tense interview:

# **Tim Burchett gives CNN reporter a southern smackdown for trashing DOGE 's "waste and abuse" cuts**
Tennessee Republican Tim Burchett **[schooled CNN reporter Brianna Keilar for doubting](https://substack.com/redirect/79d3f5fa-c34f-4d13-9517-7aee61995792?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** the efficacy of Elon Musk and DOGE's effort to eliminate "waste, fraud and abuse" in the federal government.
> _**["Y'all at CNN do not support one dagum cut!" ](https://substack.com/redirect/79d3f5fa-c34f-4d13-9517-7aee61995792?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**_
[Watch Video](https://substack.com/redirect/79d3f5fa-c34f-4d13-9517-7aee61995792?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
[](https://substack.com/redirect/79d3f5fa-c34f-4d13-9517-7aee61995792?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Keilar questioned "the benefits" of DOGE's cuts to the waste, fraud and abuse in the government, adding that opponents to DOGE have challenged the GOP's plan to balance the budget, claiming it cannot be achieved with department cuts alone, but would need to include government entitlements like Social Security.
"You're asking the people who created the problem, did they make a mistake," Burchett pressed back. "Of course they're going to tell you 'no we didn't make a mistake'!'"
"No one imagined the millions and billions of dollars that are going out,... Do you know we're giving $40 million a week to the Taliban right now?!!" he continued. "They want to demonize Trump and they want to demonize Elon Musk!"
Keilar protested the congressman's claim, saying she "just wants to talk about the math."
"Look at the math! If Elon Musk says he wants to find $1 trillion of waste, fraud and abuse, why don't we let him find it, what does that hurt?" Burchett said. "Y'all at CNN don't support one dagum cut!!"
[Watch Video](https://substack.com/redirect/79d3f5fa-c34f-4d13-9517-7aee61995792?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

Hi Peter:
In less than two weeks, on March 24, the fair maps movement will once again be arguing in front of the U.S. Supreme Court in a case called _Louisiana v. Callais._

**A quick recap:**
This case was born after an ideologically driven, conservative federal court wrongly struck down Louisiana’s newly enacted VRA-compliant map, ignoring U.S. Supreme Court precedent in _Allen v. Milligan_ — which affirmed the equal opportunity for Black voters to elect candidates of their choice.
**Our affiliate, the National Redistricting Foundation (NRF), proudly supported some of the voters fighting to ensure that their voices would be heard and their rights protected.**
That fight is now at the Supreme Court.

**What the outcome of this case could mean:**
This case will determine not only the future of Louisiana’s Voting Rights Act (VRA)-compliant congressional map, but also could impact the future of Section 2 of the VRA itself.
As A.G. Holder put it, **“The current map provides equal representation for all voters in the state and must be maintained. A decision that does not recognize that fact or that weakens the Voting Rights Act of 1965 would signal an alarming retreat into a past that so many have fought so long and so hard to pull the country from. The eyes of the nation will be on the Court.”**

**How supporters like you can help:**
I’ve been working on voting rights for over a decade, and I’ve seen firsthand how critical it is to have fair maps if we want to have accountable, responsive leaders. Fair and representative redistricting is the lifeblood of a healthy democracy.
Right now, there are folks who want to take us backward — to a time before the Voting Rights Act. Fighting back for a truly representative democracy and for racial equality in voting is as important as ever. Moments like this remind us that we cannot stop working to ensure that every eligible voter has the opportunity to make their voice heard, no matter who they are or where they come from.
**We’ll be in touch with more about _Louisiana vs. Callais_ soon. Until then, I hope you’ll consider [making a donation to support All On The Line’s critical work in Louisiana and across the country.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/103749616/533121441/-766669867?refcode=don_aotl_tier1_email_OTDLA2_email_20250312-AOTL-Tier1-OTDLA2-OM_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20250312-AOTL-Tier1-OTDLA2-OM_&utm_campaign=OTDLA2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk2IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImRhZWZhYjZhLThkZmYtZWYxMS05MGNkLTAwMjI0ODJhOWZiNyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=4YJCLoDLpE-Dz9kfelxyE6kzNelHIfwgTHIVrkYh-ac=)**

clean_body: Our latest updates on this case | = Hi Peter: In less than two weeks, on March 24, the fair maps movement will once again be arguing in front of the U.S. Supreme Court in a case called Louisiana v. Callais. A quick recap: This case was born after an ideologically driven, conservative federal court wrongly struck down Louisiana’s newly enacted VRA-compliant map, ignoring U.S. Supreme Court precedent in Allen v. Milligan — which affirmed the equal opportunity for Black voters to elect candidates of their choice. Our affiliate, the National Redistricting Foundation (NRF), proudly supported some of the voters fighting to ensure that their voices would be heard and their rights protected. That fight is now at the Supreme Court. What the outcome of this case could mean: This case will determine not only the future of Louisiana’s Voting Rights Act (VRA)-compliant congressional map, but also could impact the future of Section 2 of the VRA itself. As A.G. Holder put it, “The current map provides equal representation for all voters in the state and must be maintained. A decision that does not recognize that fact or that weakens the Voting Rights Act of 1965 would signal an alarming retreat into a past that so many have fought so long and so hard to pull the country from. The eyes of the nation will be on the Court.” How supporters like you can help: I’ve been working on voting rights for over a decade, and I’ve seen firsthand how critical it is to have fair maps if we want to have accountable, responsive leaders. Fair and representative redistricting is the lifeblood of a healthy democracy. Right now, there are folks who want to take us backward — to a time before the Voting Rights Act. Fighting back for a truly representative democracy and for racial equality in voting is as important as ever. Moments like this remind us that we cannot stop working to ensure that every eligible voter has the opportunity to make their voice heard, no matter who they are or where they come from. We’ll be in touch with more about Louisiana vs. Callais soon. Until then, I hope you’ll consider = = Adelante! Olivia Olivia Mendoza Director of Litigation and Policy, All On The Line is the grassroots advocacy campaign supported by the National Redistricting Action Fund. What do you call someone who spent 25 years in uniform serving his country? Who flew 39 combat missions, and won the Distinguished Flying Cross twice? Who completed four missions to space as an astronaut, and commanded the space shuttle twice?

You'll be able to learn from my boss--and Hillsdale College President--Larry P. Arnn as he teaches this course through [four novels: George Orwell's _1984_ , Aldous Huxley's _Brave New World_ , Arthur Koestler's _Darkness at Noon_ , and C.S. Lewis's _That Hideous Strength_ (my personal favorite of these four)](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/s/c/dNKME8vQ9db8EztPoJb0wibUZszp-nqYm0Hl_NdNmQd-oUE7Uoewo6VwC3E8bDAAK39T-Hqs4b7rlD36t_r6HFpjdUrc3Lt2Ggvq6wTWcfLssUPIdmxH0YHb1tFtsULZiJzGY6FxBivCDGiWhavgZz_Z11QWU25lglqw541qFzVS0mKf-KHXPhbSwi1qlRY16CEUqnSOrlwmPsxH5nPZau6RdukDpMyvIH47ngQG-HNzQS5tAhYxcoC35_pYzEZ8V4jNWer2OmOqQrbE6RKXolbvsQngXp09mq35BzhK0nv8KuqUWAfXDmCp5H73AzyNYUdKcqUMAEUDBY-Hk7hjJJQwgtYtHKyYtOVk525yb9qq2jT8bDpkT7D5YzH1WA_tZ_68_MuVgVsPbdUNpxYEAlBYUROJwMM2NHz3_d9M4jUPEUwG0JYJIlPyv1nncVMcVENpbCOXMbFTT8WzA10/H9HJ-_-FeUZZG0p1JDTgIYuE0VhgVgvw/6).

**You 'll find the worlds of these novels are eerily familiar...**

* Endless wars, a surveillance state, and the distortion of history and truth by the media define not only Oceania--the dystopian world of _1984_ --but also contemporary America.
* The drugged and pleasure-obsessed inhabitants of _Brave New World_ reflect a troubling reality in modern America, where addictions to alcohol, fentanyl, pornography, food, gambling, and even social media are on the rise.
* A country stages a show trial for a political figure who fails to conform to ideological orthodoxy--a theme central to _Darkness at Noon_ and a striking parallel to the events of the past several years in American politics.
* If you've heard experts throw around the phrase "Trust the science," you may recognize the bureaucratic despotism of N.I.C.E. (National Institute of Co-ordinated Experiments) in _That Hideous Strength_.

We're at a turning point in our nation's history. After decades of far-Left despotism, the American people have said, "ENOUGH!"

**And that means --we can stop the totalitarian trends and ideologies in our country before they are entirely and utterly irreversible. **

I saw a T-shirt one of our Hillsdale students was sporting this fall, with the clever slogan, "Make 1984 fiction again!" I don't know about you, but I wholeheartedly agree with that sentiment.

That's why we need you to make this course available to as many Americans as possible. It will be one of the most important ways you can recognize the far-Left's totalitarian tendencies.

**[You can do that by supporting"Totalitarian Novels" after you sign-up for the free course today](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/s/c/LbD0yrrDr8hOVS8HDuWcDaif8gX_In2zkcVLCh3MFDLQkdB6o-_faHp5s5w87QKku0GjemadhcJZYDMffi0WuD0lg_1yE3-Qmt7BpFYqCHqkZq3_H8VSOL0qg2BIXWTUPmE6PZ9hVu31FaxNIbfaoJ8Ut626VwTvbpf7Y1AvjVFuXemrUeuJSmJZgCmB3RJUxhSO61G2DTaECYXX6py4aj2f-gX3gauD-RmNu-JTUsz_mbp7Yalsf-BT4hEeILl6ez8l04K18AX-0NUkwoZT17dM49ler7wjdW_M2c4O_FGQFmIEbpGDv-wqLDR8zR19HnuUP1LWqAP5OwLTQsyp5zEJk-vuO0IVzRRFlGpF_97HQSnKxowTuMB4aPQmMiKY3hMnQ7Aw1OTGQnTP96sr2VS-EHq_gPE3CC1hiZ1jFyZSrTOoZblHjMdezwElNRNp9F9otmrXijyKjKecZss/Tve7X51tMDD3Q5lGEJT6Tbid6SEBl5n6/6).**

>> For your gift of $100 or more, you will receive a video boxset of "Totalitarian Novels" from Hillsdale College. It's one small way we can say "thank you" for your support of our educational outreach.

Your support will help promote this course and sign up as many people--especially young people!--as possible. And you will help us continue to expand our educational outreach even further.

The more people who understand the nature of totalitarianism, the less likely it will gain a foothold in America.

**Will you join us in helping promote this free online course?** You can click on the secure link below to sign up for the course and make your tax-deductible gift:

[**https://online.hillsdale.edu/courses/register/totalitarian-novels**](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/s/c/DcL1Tp9vPjLDZ-gZQJ0bioHoDszU9ulwz44xp_8yKpgUJycNI6yMuqXlre-3IsooXway5YHtFJxbSDNvIFN-IHOfZpE0DHK8H4WvZYRvfEsMEUgP9dEmkefKUQwuirweVnpqXvBlibQgcDlApk1qZsof4jptMwncCWWu5QUG2VdBOgtK708IAz4kubqq20fepRktmVJ41dVB1nIu-Ebtdiakrp_IlbQUDkhA_CzPmdlS_MzufH-L_76TupQvaDZFxWuI50hljuEJmUjcHutsK30DziR3h2KFHPcyUCB03Q2upBe1AnE6J3zWl6Cj9KoJXeg03HWdj2xHc8cbVbhsWGo8ZkOwql1Z6axhQJitC6iuNge3sk5HEKgA7ogatLDpvll3_oDUuMMUYS23wQlNUkzPvZIzbE4QZhIf8LzesQgbm5zHedwjMjkcW-6NJfbsLkjNWlEws8odAGvuncg/Kyalshzgr0YuIbdJ6Lo1XohZCus64-u6/6)

Hillsdale College

body:
Young men may have voted for Trump, but they don’t like his policies. We can win them back — if we offer something better.
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20250312-1&t=1&akid=1845%2E587540%2EezYugF)
Hi Peter,
There’s a dangerous myth that young men are lost to the Republican Party. But here’s the truth: **they may have voted for Trump, but they don’t like his policies.**
Trump’s approval among young men on the economy **_just dropped 14 points in a month_ **— because they see the reality of what MAGA policies mean for their lives.
**That’s why we’re not giving up on them. Instead, we’re building something better.**
At Leaders We Deserve, we’re electing young, bold progressives who are ready to take on Trumpism — not just by opposing it, but by actually improving people’s lives. That means:
✅ Tackling student debt and housing costs
✅ Fighting for fair wages and workers’ rights
✅ Taking real action on gun violence and the climate crisis
✅ Making sure every young person has a real shot at success
The best way to bring young voters — **including young men** — into the Democratic coalition isn’t just to attack Trump. **It’s to offer something real _and_ meaningful.**
**[Can you chip in $5 or more today to help us elect the young leaders who will take on Trumpism — and win?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20250312-1?refcode=em20250312-1845&amount=5&refcode2=1845_587540_ezYugF&akid=1845%2E587540%2EezYugF)**

We’ve already helped elect young progressives up and down the ballot — and with your support, we can keep expanding our movement. Our victories electing six young progressive candidates last November showed us that when Democrats run on real solutions, young voters turn out.
**Let’s keep proving that.**
In solidarity,
Leaders We Deserve

body:

Dear Fellow American,

I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter.

It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future.

A movement is growing, led by progressives—but supported by many well-meaning Americans—to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution.

That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a National Survey on Presidential Selection.

By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue—views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders.

You can complete the National Survey on Presidential Selection by using the link below:

http://trk.victorymailings.com/?xtl=17x64w94u6dfph5of2icpeku8bc4v2ereqy57epwhk9630g8hgt37pchbj4k20bjs7oy85ywcrqccek4ojpuiaj7r0s0f9nwlxw9s0l9egl8pe34tli24g3ogotn5svs1ro5neg4whr85ypsk4uwyo5tqs1h16&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=st19ai&__onlt=t
http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=st19ai&__onlt=t

Do you think that most Americans understand how the Electoral College works and its role in preserving free and representative government?

YES
http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=st19ai&__onlt=t

NO
http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=st19ai&__onlt=t

For most of our nation's history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government.

But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.

This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America's schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics—too many Americans simply don't understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty.

Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching millions of Americans in all 50 states.

These efforts, which aim to counter the Left's domination over most of our schools, include:

Teaching millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as "Constitution 101" and "The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;"

Reaching over six million households and businesses nationwide with Imprimis, Hillsdale's free digest of liberty;

Promoting constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;

Sending millions of pocket-size copies of America's founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America; and

Restoring excellence to K-12 education by helping establish and guiding classical K-12 schools nationwide and providing, free of charge, Hillsdale's American classical K-12 curriculum (including American civics) to thousands of American educators and homeschoolers.

Your answers to the National Survey on Presidential Selection will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty—including the importance of the Electoral College.

And this is especially important in this critical time for America's future.

So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our National Survey on Presidential Selection and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time.

You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:

http://trk.victorymailings.com/?xtl=17x64w94u6dfph5of2icpeku8bc4v2ereqhem8xoff13msvr9tzrf8x6rgh5b6isibv5nh365tmzf4kzees6d09n4h95j4k79o968li83ghl8yjyuy8u6oqmvvv8936rzb12xcmk4rdtgl5jx4pyo1z6tclvtf&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=st19ai&__onlt=t
http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=st19ai&__onlt=t

And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift.

Since 1844, Hillsdale has been "pursuing truth and defending liberty." Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans.

The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work.

Please represent your state and take the National Survey on Presidential Selection today. Thank you for your time and attention—and for your friendship and support of liberty.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn

President, Hillsdale College

Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

Meet Coach Tuberville:

**Coach Tuberville was born in Camden, Arkansas, the third of three children of Olive and Charles Tuberville. College Football’s 2004 Coach of the Year and two-time SEC Coach of the Year, Tommy Tuberville is most often recognized for his success on the field. But it is the legacy of his father, a highly decorated WWII veteran and Purple Heart recipient, that motivates Coach Tuberville to give back to the brave men and women of the United States Armed Forces.

In 1989 Coach Tuberville met his future wife, Suzanne Fette, at the Sugar Bowl in New Orleans. They were married in 1991 and have two boys, Tucker and Troy, who continue to make their dad proud.

In his career as a College Football Coach, Tommy started a long and successful career at the University of Miami, starting as a graduate assistant and rising to the Hurricanes' defensive coordinator. He led the Canes to three AP national championships and coached future Hall of Famers Ray Lewis and Warren Sapp, as well as Dwayne "The Rock" Johnson.

In 1998, Coach Tuberville was announced as the next head coach for the Auburn Tigers. Tuberville’s time at Auburn was a success by any measure, as the Tigers captured eight consecutive bowl appearances, including five New Year’s Day bowl appearances, five SEC Western Division titles, one SEC Championship, and a 13-0 season in 2004, after which Coach Tuberville was once again named the AP’s SEC Coach of the Year. For his efforts during the perfect 2004 season, Tuberville would be named Paul “Bear” Bryant Coach of the Year, Associated Press Coach of the Year, Walter Camp Coach of the Year, Sporting News Coach of the Year, and AFCA Coach of the Year, among others.

_In 2020, Coach Tuberville became Senator Tuberville, winning his election to represent all Alabamians in the United States Senate with the full support of President Trump. Since then, he's supported President Trump's America-First policies while fighting off the Radical Left. In his first term as Senator, Tommy was one of eight Republicans to vote against certifying the 2020 election, has been a strong pro-life advocate, and called out Democrats for being pro-crime.

Now, Coach Tuberville is running for re-election so he can continue representing Alabamians and Americans in the United States Senate. The Radical Left has him circled as a prime target to defeat in the 2026 Midterm Elections. Can he count on your support? _

For his efforts during the perfect 2004 season, Tuberville would be named Paul “Bear” Bryant Coach of the Year, Associated Press Coach of the Year, Walter Camp Coach of the Year, Sporting News Coach of the Year, and AFCA Coach of the Year, among others. In 2020, Coach Tuberville became Senator Tuberville, winning his election to represent all Alabamians in the United States Senate with the full support of President Trump. Since then, he's supported President Trump's America-First policies while fighting off the Radical Left. In his first term as Senator, Tommy was one of eight Republicans to vote against certifying the 2020 election, has been a strong pro-life advocate, and called out Democrats for being pro-crime. Now, Coach Tuberville is running for re-election so he can continue representing Alabamians and Americans in the United States Senate. The Radical Left has him circled as a prime target to defeat in the 2026 Midterm Elections. Can he count on your support? So, why am I running again?

Because working class Wisconsinites deserve a voice in Congress -- someone who knows what it’s like to work for a living. And we’ve proven we can make real inroads when we show up, listen, and focus on issues that matter: good jobs, affordable health care, and lowering costs for working families.

In an election year that saw many voters frustrated with the national Democratic Party, we still outperformed the US Senator Tammy Baldwin by 5,000 votes in this district. We even out-paced Kamala Harris by 9,000 votes.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/103752466/533131443/-1583519984?amount=10&refcode=MGP_EM_SPLITFR_180DO_250312_1_1&refcode2=313fabff-9aff-ef11-90cd-0022482a9fb7&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NTkyOCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzMTNmYWJmZi05YWZmLWVmMTEtOTBjZC0wMDIyNDgyYTlmYjciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Jy0ICoXO6I6UJtt58TcrnNcyfzCdrWEB4Yuju2fUlys=)
**Peter, we won more votes than any Democrat in WI-03 in nearly a decade.**

It’s clear we’re on to something, but winning back rural, working-class voters takes time. And the tough truth is that Democrats lost these voters' trust over years of neglect. It won’t be rebuilt overnight, but we know progress is possible if we show up and keep fighting.

**I’m running because our work _has_ to continue.**

We’re on month three of complete far right control in Washington, and folks are learning in real time that taking a buzz saw to the government won’t lower the price of eggs, or the cost of gas in your car.

These are the voters we need to win over, we won't take any voter for granted or write anyone off who is starting from a different viewpoint. That's how we've done things for generations in Wisconsin, and that’s why we’ll finish the job and unseat Derrick Van Orden this time around.
